jobs.title: Account Executive - Commodities - Middle East
jobs.description: The Sales team is looking for a highly motivated Account Executive who is excited about selling a disruptive technology solution in the commodities sector and hunting new logos across the Middle Eas Key Responsibilities: • Own the full sales cycle. Manage inbound new business leads, develop opportunities, demo the product, and close sales. Focus on outbound activities to drive pipeline • Build relationships with prospects and internal stakeholders to grow new business. • Manage a territory, responding to clients’ requests promptly and thoroughly, and having a growth quota every year • Work collaboratively with our global Sales team, product, and market analysts to build the best product in the market and close exciting deals • Provide accurate and up-to-date forecasts for any given month or year. • Close new business consistently at or above quota level Experience & Background: What you'll need (Must-haves): 5+ years of B2B commercial sales experience as an Account Executive, preferably within a SaaS, market intelligence, or data vendor environment. Proven track record as a proactive "hunter"—consistently sourcing, negotiating, and closing new business opportunities to drive revenue growth. Strong negotiation, interpersonal, and communication skills, with professional fluency in English plus French or German. High self-motivation, discipline, and adaptability to thrive independently within dynamic, fast-paced environments while contributing to shared team success. Nice-to-haves: Commercial exposure to or working knowledge of global trade, maritime intelligence, or commodities markets and trends. Hands-on proficiency with modern sales tools and CRMs (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, ZoomInfo). Professional working proficiency in additional languages. Willingness and flexibility to travel as needed for client engagements and industry conferences.

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Strategic Planning & Execution Coordinate and manage the company's goal-setting processes, monitoring progress against key objectives and identifying potential deviations. Support leadership in defining, implementing, and tracking Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to ensure alignment across departments. Conduct market, business, and operational research to develop actionable insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making. Analyze organizational performance and help identify opportunities to improve execution and achieve business objectives. Decision-Making & Leadership Alignment Ensure employees have timely access to relevant business information, promoting transparency, alignment, and informed decision-making. Conduct analyses and experiments to evaluate business opportunities, identify trends, and recommend improvements. Prepare strategic content, presentations, and performance updates for company-wide meetings, leadership discussions, and team offsites. Support communication and alignment between senior leadership and cross-functional teams. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Collaborate with department leaders to implement and continuously improve company-wide operating processes and frameworks. Develop efficient systems for knowledge sharing, documentation, and collaboration across a distributed workforce. Manage and continuously improve Notion as the organization's central knowledge management platform and Single Source of Truth. Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions to streamline workflows and improve productivity. Support high-priority business initiatives and contribute wherever additional operational or strategic support is needed. Explore and promote the use of AI tools and emerging technologies to improve internal processes and overall business efficiency. Requirements: 3–6 years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, technology investment banking, venture capital, startup operations, or a combination of these fields. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience using data and research to inform business decisions. Good understanding of SaaS business models and key financial and operational metrics, including revenue, margins, operating costs, and cash burn. Ability to interpret financial reports, assess business performance, and develop informed perspectives on organizational health. Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive approach to managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and interact effectively with senior stakeholders. Proven stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across different functions and influence outcomes without direct authority. Adaptability and a willingness to work in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity is part of everyday operations. A continuous improvement mindset, combined with initiative, curiosity, and a practical approach to problem-solving. Genuine interest in AI tools and their potential to improve business operations, with a willingness to experiment, share insights, and contribute to broader AI adoption. Proficiency with macOS and confidence working remotely with collaboration and productivity tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom. Strong written English skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different time zones and geographical locations. Benefits: Competitive salary: The advertised annual salary range is $92,000–$125,000 for US-based candidates, depending on geographical location, experience, and expertise. Compensation for Poland-based candidates will be determined according to regional benchmarks and discussed during the recruitment process. Remote-first flexib

jobs.title: Vice President, Intelligence & Impact
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Partner with the CEO and senior leadership team to define organizational strategy, establish priorities, and guide resource allocation based on evidence, expected impact, and strategic objectives. Evaluate the organization's global portfolio of initiatives, assessing their effectiveness, feasibility, cost-efficiency, strategic alignment, and potential to improve animal welfare outcomes. Provide data-driven recommendations on which programs and initiatives should be expanded, maintained, redesigned, or discontinued, while identifying opportunities for geographic expansion, new program areas, and strategic partnerships. Develop a proactive strategic intelligence function to monitor emerging trends, risks, and opportunities across animal agriculture, corporate practices, public policy, technology, and relevant markets. Translate complex research, external developments, and quantitative and qualitative data into clear, actionable recommendations that support organizational strategy and systemic change. Establish an organization-wide impact measurement framework, including meaningful performance indicators, evaluation methodologies, and learning mechanisms to assess effectiveness across programs and geographies. Ensure that insights and evaluation findings consistently inform strategic decisions, operational improvements, and resource allocation. Lead technology-enabled transformation by identifying opportunities to improve productivity and organizational effectiveness through AI, automation, integrated data systems, and emerging technologies. Oversee the development, integration, and adoption of technology solutions that streamline workflows, strengthen decision-making, and improve operational performance. Define and implement a practical technology roadmap, prioritizing investments according to organizational needs, expected value, scalability, and implementation feasibility. Collaborate with IT to ensure technology solutions and data systems are secure, integrated, scalable, and aligned with organizational priorities. Build and lead a lean, multidisciplinary Intelligence & Impact team covering strategy, research, impact assessment, analytics, and technology development. Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the CEO, offering independent perspectives, challenging assumptions, and delivering clear, decision-ready recommendations. Work closely with regional and functional leaders to strengthen execution capabilities, encourage collaboration, and maintain accountability for measurable results. Contribute actively to senior leadership discussions and organization-wide decision-making, fostering a culture of evidence-based thinking, innovation, and continuous improvement. Requirements: Significant senior leadership experience in strategy, organizational transformation, analytics, impact evaluation, technology, or a related discipline. Proven ability to assess complex opportunities, navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and translate sophisticated analysis into practical strategic decisions. Strong quantitative, qualitative, financial, and operational skills, with the ability to combine analytical rigor with sound business judgment. Demonstrated experience leading technology-enabled transformation initiatives, including systems development or integration, AI adoption, automation, and process optimization. Experience developing and implementing performance measurement frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and data-informed decision-making processes. Proven ability to build and lead multidisciplinary teams, influence senior stakeholders, and collaborate effectively across functions, cultures, and geographical regions. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify opportunities for greater efficiency, collaboration, and long-term impact. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to present complex findings clearly and influence decisions at exe

jobs.title: Director of B2B Marketing
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Serve as a senior strategic marketing partner for a portfolio of B2B clients, providing direction, expertise, and ongoing counsel. Develop integrated marketing strategies and plans aligned with client business objectives, target audiences, and growth priorities. Translate business goals into actionable channel strategies, campaigns, performance indicators, and measurement frameworks. Build strong relationships with client executives and confidently communicate strategic recommendations, campaign results, and opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand and strengthen client marketing programs based on performance insights and changing business needs. Manage relationships with external vendors and partners to support effective execution and scalable results. Lead paid and organic B2B marketing strategies across relevant channels, including paid search, paid social, display advertising, and retargeting. Oversee organic growth initiatives across Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Search Engine Optimization (SEO), content marketing, and organic social media. Develop audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and channel recommendations based on buyer behavior and client objectives. Coordinate with specialists across GEO, SEO, outbound email, content, creative, social media, and public relations to deliver integrated campaigns. Establish and monitor KPIs that connect marketing activities to lead generation, conversion, revenue, and broader business outcomes. Analyze campaign and channel performance to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring improvement. Use data to guide decisions related to budget allocation, audience targeting, messaging, content strategy, and channel mix. Translate complex performance data into clear, practical insights and recommendations for clients. Continuously test and optimize campaigns to improve engagement, demand generation, conversion rates, and return on investment. Provide strategic direction and oversight to cross-functional teams supporting B2B client accounts, ensuring consistent quality and accountability. Contribute to new business development through marketing strategy, proposals, pitches, and client presentations. Collaborate with senior leadership to establish best practices, improve workflows, and strengthen the organization's B2B marketing capabilities. Requirements: At least 10 years of B2B marketing experience, including significant experience working in an agency environment. Demonstrated expertise in both paid and organic marketing, with the ability to develop and manage integrated, multi-channel strategies. Strong knowledge of paid advertising, including paid search, paid social, display campaigns, and retargeting. Solid understanding of B2B buyer journeys, demand generation, lead generation, conversion strategies, and marketing funnels. Proven experience managing B2B client relationships and advising senior-level stakeholders. Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and translate data into meaningful business recommendations. Experience managing marketing budgets and making informed decisions about channel selection, investment, and spend allocation. Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to influence clients and senior decision-makers. Strategic and creative thinking combined with a practical, hands-on approach to marketing execution. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to oversee multiple clients, priorities, and campaigns. Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced, fully remote environment. A proactive, accountable mindset and a strong focus on delivering measurable results. Benefits: 100% remote work: Work from anywhere in the world, with the flexibility to create a productive working environment. Healthcare coverage: Choice of three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus de

jobs.title: (Senior) FP&A Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: In this role, you will take ownership of financial planning and performance management, providing strategic insights and supporting business-wide decision-making. Your main responsibilities will include: Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes across the business. Translate financial and operational performance into actionable insights through variance analysis, identifying risks, opportunities, and recommendations for senior leadership. Partner with commercial, operational, functional, local finance, and group finance teams to support strategic initiatives and improve business performance. Develop and maintain robust financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting packages to support decision-making and investment cases. Ensure alignment between local German reporting requirements and group-level expectations within a U.S. publicly listed company environment. Drive continuous improvements across FP&A processes, planning tools, data quality, reporting automation, and performance management routines. Collaborate with external auditors, system implementation partners, and corporate reporting teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across financial processes. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence stakeholders in an international business environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Approximately 7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, controlling, corporate finance, or a related finance function, preferably within an international or matrixed organization. Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, management reporting, variance analysis, and business performance management. Good understanding of the relationships between the balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and cash flow statement. Advanced Excel skills and practical experience with ERP, financial planning, and reporting tools such as Oracle NetSuite, Oracle Fusion, Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Hyperion, OneStream, or similar platforms. Strong commercial mindset, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence strategic decisions. Fluent English is required. Experience preparing board materials, earnings support schedules, management review packs, or group reporting deliverables is a plus. Exposure to finance transformation, planning system implementation, BI dashboards, or reporting automation projects is an advantage. An MBA, CFA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent professional qualification is considered a strong asset. Previous experience in a high-growth, complex, multinational, or publicly listed company environment is beneficial. Benefits Competitive salary: Starting from €55,000 gross per year, depending on location, skills, and experience. Remote-first flexibility: Fully remote position within a time zone of approximately ±2 hours of Central European Time. Work from anywhere: Access to a flexible working arrangement through a dedicated WorkFlex program. Well-being support: A dedicated Well-Being Day to recharge and focus on personal well-being. Fitness benefits: Subsidized gym memberships to support an active and healthy lifestyle. Learning and development: Training and Development Allowance to invest in professional growth and expand your skills. Team connection: Annual team meetups bringing together colleagues from across the globe. Inclusive culture: Work in a diverse, international, and collaborative environment that values different perspectives and equal opportunities.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist (English & Russian)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Digital Marketing Specialist, you will manage the operational and creative execution of digital marketing campaigns, ensuring that every channel and customer touchpoint is properly configured, consistent, and optimized. Your responsibilities will include: Set up, maintain, and quality-check webinar landing pages and supporting technical elements, including automated emails, call-to-action buttons, and tracking links. Moderate live webinars, ensuring smooth technical delivery and strong audience engagement. Write, edit, and implement conversational copy for ManyChat chatbot automations. Build, configure, and optimize trigger-based automated chatbot flows. Research and evaluate promotional channels, identify suitable placement opportunities, and communicate with channel administrators. Create and proofread persuasive promotional copy for channel placements and seeding campaigns. Track campaign activity and results in spreadsheets, monitoring performance and conversion rates. Write, configure, and manage email marketing campaigns and automated sequences. Create and manage call-booking links and scheduling workflows in HubSpot. Maintain the company website through regular content updates and adjustments. Requirements The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented digital marketing professional who combines strong copywriting skills with hands-on technical execution. You should be comfortable managing several marketing activities independently while maintaining consistent quality and reliable follow-through. The following qualifications are expected: At least 2 years of practical experience in digital marketing. Advanced English proficiency (C1 level). Advanced Russian proficiency (C1 level). Strong written communication skills in English, particularly for marketing and promotional content. Proven ability to execute tasks reliably and follow projects through to completion. Excellent attention to detail, organization, and consistency. Ability to manage multiple campaigns and workflows while maintaining high-quality standards. Additional advantages: Experience managing website content through platforms such as WordPress. Previous digital marketing experience in the recruitment or human resources sector. Familiarity with marketing automation, webinar platforms, email marketing tools, and chatbot systems. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement. Full-time position. Flexible working hours. Working hours aligned with Central European Time (CET), or within a three-hour difference. Comprehensive onboarding and training. Structured tasks and clear feedback. Collaborative, friendly, and international team environment. Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven organization.

jobs.title: Email Marketing Manager (Klaviyo)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Email Marketing Manager, you will oversee the execution and performance of email marketing initiatives, ensuring that campaigns are delivered efficiently and contribute to clients' business growth. Your responsibilities will include: Coordinate and monitor multiple email marketing projects, ensuring deadlines, priorities, and deliverables remain on track. Brief and collaborate with the design team to develop effective and engaging email creatives. Write persuasive, conversion-focused copy tailored to each brand's audience and objectives. Build, configure, and manage email campaigns, automated flows, and pop-ups within Klaviyo. Support customer communication initiatives across additional channels, including WhatsApp and print mailings. Use modern AI-powered tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflow efficiency. Monitor campaign execution and performance, identifying opportunities to improve engagement and commercial results. Take ownership of project outcomes and proactively identify solutions to operational or performance challenges. Requirements The ideal candidate combines practical Klaviyo experience with strong copywriting skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage several projects independently. You should be proactive, accountable, and motivated by delivering measurable results. The following qualifications are expected: At least one year of intensive, hands-on experience with Klaviyo. Proven ability to independently build and manage email campaigns, automated flows, and pop-ups. Previous copywriting experience, with the ability to create persuasive content that drives conversions. Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Fluent written and spoken German is essential. Experience in e-commerce or a marketing agency is an advantage. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for results. A solution-oriented mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality work. Genuine interest in continuous learning and professional development. Customer-focused approach, with the motivation to go the extra mile to support client success. Benefits Annual gross salary of €45,000–€55,000. Permanent, full-time employment contract. Fully remote working arrangement, available worldwide. 40-hour working week. 20 days of annual paid leave. Direct collaboration with company founders and opportunities for accelerated learning. Clear processes, autonomy, and a high level of trust without micromanagement. Opportunities to take on greater responsibility and grow with the team over time. Long-term opportunity to contribute to the development of a growing business.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Health Insurance
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Business Analyst, you will act as the link between business departments and IT teams, ensuring that insurance requirements are accurately understood, documented, and translated into practical solutions. Your responsibilities will include: Analyze business requirements and operational processes within the Swiss health and accident insurance sector. Develop appropriate solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and IT specialists. Manage requirements throughout the full lifecycle, including analysis, concept development, specification, implementation, and validation. Contribute to the continuous improvement of insurance applications and business processes, particularly claims processing and automated invoice verification. Ensure the functional and technical quality of applications, supporting error analysis and resolution when needed. Configure and maintain insurance applications, including keeping reference data and tariff information accurate and up to date. Participate in customer projects and coordinate release planning and implementation with customers, business teams, developers, and system providers. Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in the Swiss insurance market and identify the resulting business and system requirements. Requirements The ideal candidate combines a solid understanding of health insurance operations with strong business analysis and requirements engineering capabilities. You should be comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of business and technical stakeholders. The following qualifications are expected: Degree or professional training in business informatics, computer science, or a commercial discipline, supported by strong IT affinity. Several years of professional experience in the Swiss health and/or accident insurance sector. In-depth knowledge of claims processes under the Swiss Health Insurance Act (KVG) and/or Insurance Contract Act (VVG). Experience with insurance tariffs and tariff-related processes is an advantage. Proven experience in business analysis, requirements engineering, and the analysis, design, and specification of business requirements. Familiarity with insurance applications, ideally Adcubum Syrius or Sumex. Experience configuring applications; knowledge of SQL is an advantage. Knowledge of software testing, quality assurance, or release management is a plus. Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders. Excellent written and spoken German, with a professional communication style. Benefits Remote working arrangement, open to candidates worldwide. Fixed-term employment contract. Opportunity to contribute to projects within the Swiss health and accident insurance sector. Potential to work across business analysis, insurance application optimization, and IT implementation. Start as soon as possible.

Design, develop, and maintain scalable billing services covering fee policy configuration, fee calculation, invoice generation, billing adjustments, and reconciliation. Replace manual billing workflows with automated, reliable processes that improve operational efficiency and reduce errors. Build and maintain robust data pipelines and integrations across systems such as Snowflake, Salesforce, Ledger, and internal financial services, ensuring accurate data flows from transaction processing through invoicing and reporting. Establish engineering practices that protect financial accuracy and auditability, including idempotency, traceability, reconciliation, exception handling, and comprehensive audit trails. Lead technical design submissions, architecture reviews, and service design, applying domain-driven design, hexagonal architecture, and event-driven patterns. Guide the team in managing production workloads, including message-processing failures, dead-letter queues, incident resolution, and system resilience. Set expectations for testing, CI/CD, documentation, and technical debt management to ensure consistent delivery and long-term platform maintainability. Balance delivery speed, scalability, reliability, and business priorities while maintaining ownership of business-critical services. Requirements: At least 7 years of backend software engineering experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Java or Kotlin and Spring Boot. Experience mentoring engineers through technical design, code reviews, problem-solving, and complex delivery challenges. A strong production ownership mindset, including experience operating business-critical systems, participating in on-call rotations, and managing incidents. jobs.title: Test Manager - Output/CCM/Document Management Systems
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Test Manager, you will take ownership of the overall testing approach and ensure that all activities are properly planned, coordinated, and executed throughout the system replacement project. Your responsibilities will include: Develop and own the test strategy and test concept for replacing the existing Customer Communication Management (CCM) platform. Define and manage legacy-versus-new system comparisons, ensuring documents are generated using identical data streams across both environments. Plan, coordinate, monitor, and control all testing activities from initial design through implementation. Work closely with the Product Owner, development teams, solution architects, and business departments to align testing objectives and priorities. Design approaches for testing documents that cannot be triggered manually, such as payment reminders and month-end processing outputs, using simulations, scheduled execution, or batch testing environments. Establish and maintain test data management processes, including use-case-based datasets such as real estate financing scenarios, while ensuring compliance with data protection requirements. Coordinate integration testing, end-to-end testing, performance and volume testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Lead defect management activities, ensuring issues are documented, prioritized, tracked, and resolved effectively. Provide transparent test progress reports to project management and steering committees. Assess implementation readiness and provide recommendations for go/no-go decisions. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced Test Manager with a strong background in complex system replacement or migration projects. You should combine technical testing expertise with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with business and IT stakeholders. The following qualifications are expected: Several years of experience working as a Test Manager on large-scale system replacement or migration projects. Experience in the banking sector is an advantage. Knowledge of Customer Communication Management (CCM), output management, or document management platforms. Familiarity with solutions such as OpenText Exstream, Quadient Inspire, Compart, Messagepoint, or comparable technologies. Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and agile delivery methodologies, particularly SAFe and Scrum. Proven leadership, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across business, IT, and operational teams. ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager certification or an equivalent qualification. A clean background record, with no debt enforcement proceedings or criminal convictions. Fluent German and English communication skills. Benefits 50% part-time freelance engagement. Fully remote working arrangement, open to candidates worldwide. Potential to combine this assignment with a separate 50% Test Engineer role. Opportunity to contribute to a major CCM and document management system replacement project. Start as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Payment Operations Analyst
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take ownership of checkout funnel health by identifying emerging issues, surfacing defects, and developing alerts and insights before they become business-critical. Lead root-cause investigations into payment funnel drop-offs and declining authorization rates, distinguishing technical issues from user behavior patterns. Analyze authorization rates, decline codes, and performance across multiple payment service providers (PSPs) to identify bottlenecks and prioritize improvements. Investigate payment performance issues, including processor outages and disruptions across different stages of the checkout journey. Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and alerts that provide reliable visibility into payment funnel performance. Support regular reporting to cross-functional teams, translating payment data and customer behavior insights into clear recommendations. Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Fraud teams to diagnose issues, coordinate investigations, and drive measurable improvements in authorization rates and conversion. Communicate technical findings and business impact clearly to stakeholders without specialist payments knowledge. Help establish and improve the team's diagnostic processes, contributing practical solutions and developing into a trusted point of contact for payment funnel health. Requirements: Hands-on experience working with payment funnels in a complex, multi-provider environment. Strong understanding of payment concepts and processes, including interchange, decline codes, foreign exchange (FX), tokenization, 3D Secure (3DS), and fraud fundamentals. Demonstrated experience conducting root-cause analysis of payment funnel drop-offs, authorization declines, and performance patterns, with the ability to distinguish technical causes from behavioral factors. Strong SQL skills and the ability to independently investigate payment data and identify meaningful trends. Ability to interpret complex technical findings and customer behavior insights and communicate them clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Practical understanding of payment service provider performance and the factors affecting authorization and conversion. Familiarity with self-service business intelligence (BI) or dashboarding tools is an advantage. Experience conducting comparative analysis across multiple payment service providers is beneficial. Ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing, or high-growth environments without relying on fully established processes. A proactive, independent approach to problem-solving, with the initiative to investigate issues, test ideas, and develop solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with cross-functional teams. Good English communication skills are required; professional fluency is preferred. Benefits: Annual salary range of €40,000–€60,000, depending on experience and role scope. Opportunity to participate in an Employee Stock Options program. Performance-based and referral bonus opportunities. Additional paid leave and a personal learning budget through various bonus programs. Paid volunteering opportunities. Flexible work location, with options to work remotely, from an office, or while traveling. Opportunities to contribute to the growth and development of an international digital product. Professional development supported by structured feedback and promotion processes. Opportunities for accelerated personal and professional growth within an international team.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner (fixed-term) (m/f/d)

Support managers with recruitment activities, from workforce needs clarification and role definition to interview processes, candidate evaluation, and offer management. Empower hiring managers to take ownership of recruitment by implementing efficient hiring processes, improving interview skills, and providing practical guidance throughout the selection process. Advise managers on complex employee relations matters, including performance management, performance improvement plans, challenging conversations, and employee exits. Provide comprehensive People and Culture support across recruitment, onboarding, employee development, performance management, retention, and offboarding. Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and automation within HR operations, integrating innovative solutions into daily workflows to improve efficiency and simplify processes. Identify new opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence and automation to optimize recruitment activities and broader HR processes. Support organizational development and change management initiatives, helping managers and employees navigate evolving business needs and organizational changes. Contribute to the continuous improvement of HR practices, ensuring processes remain efficient, scalable, and aligned with business objectives. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in Human Resources, with demonstrated expertise in both talent acquisition and HR/People Business Partnering. Strong understanding of the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, employee development, and offboarding. jobs.title: Bild-Ad Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Design eye-catching, conversion-focused static advertisements for Meta platforms, including Facebook and Instagram. Research target audiences and understand their purchasing motivations to translate marketing insights, psychological triggers, hooks, and advertising angles into effective visual concepts. Develop a variety of creative formats, including product-focused advertisements, UGC-style statics, before-and-after visuals, collages, and carousels. Create new variations of successful advertisements by testing different layouts, visual hooks, messaging placements, and design approaches. Analyze performance feedback and use insights to continuously refine and optimize advertising creatives. Solid understanding of direct-response design principles, with the ability to create visuals that not only look appealing but also drive engagement, conversions, and sales. Proficiency in design software such as Adobe Photoshop, Figma, Adobe InDesign, or equivalent creative tools. Strong visual design skills, including an excellent understanding of layouts, typography, composition, and visual storytelling. Ability to develop attention-grabbing concepts, compelling visual hooks, and unconventional creative approaches that help advertisements stand out in crowded social media feeds. Good understanding of consumer behavior, marketing psychology, and the elements that influence purchasing decisions. Creative mindset, curiosity, and willingness to experiment with different visual styles, formats, and advertising concepts. Our partner is looking for a Senior Strategic Sales Manager (m/f/d) based in India. We are looking for an experienced strategic sales professional to drive business growth and develop high-value client relationships across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, and Switzerland). In this role, you will lead complex B2B sales cycles, from identifying new business opportunities and engaging decision-makers to negotiating and closing strategic deals. You will promote a comprehensive portfolio of cloud consulting, engineering, managed services, managed security, and AWS reselling solutions. Working closely with technical experts, pre-sales teams, and strategic partners, you will develop tailored solutions that address customers' evolving business needs. Your mission will be to expand key accounts, generate sustainable revenue, and establish long-term partnerships. This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of strategic sales initiatives within an international, technology-driven environment. Collaborate with pre-sales, delivery, and technical specialists to design and present tailored solutions combining cloud consulting, engineering, managed services, managed security, and AWS reselling. Identify opportunities to transform individual projects into long-term service engagements, with a particular focus on managed services, recurring contracts, and sustainable revenue generation. Take full ownership of sales performance and strategic account development, ensuring achievement of revenue targets, including recurring revenue from managed services and reselling. Monitor and manage the sales pipeline, maintain accurate CRM records, prepare forecasts, and track account performance against business objectives. Explore additional business development opportunities in other European markets when required, while maintaining a primary focus on the DACH region. Requirements: 8–10 years of professional experience in consultative B2B sales, preferably involving complex IT services, cloud solutions, or comparable technology-based offerings. Demonstrated success in acquiring new strategic customers, developing key accounts, and negotiating and closing complex, multi-year commercial agreements. Proven experience selling both project-based services and recurring service contracts, such as managed services, cloud operations, managed security, AWS reselling, or SaaS solutions. Solid understanding of cloud technologies, cloud service models, commercial structures, and their business value, with AWS experience considered a significant advantage. Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage confidently with senior executives and C-level decision-makers. Excellent organizational and analytical abilities, combined with an independent, structured, and results-oriented approach to work. Experience with CRM systems, sales pipeline management, revenue forecasting, and strategic account planning. jobs.title: Senior Developer Relations, Twitter Brand Rep
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Build and maintain a visible, credible, and engaging presence on Twitter (X), actively representing the brand through regular posts, replies, and meaningful interactions with the developer community. Create and share high-quality content, including product announcements, technical insights, practical tips, industry opinions, and perspectives on emerging development trends. Participate in relevant developer discussions and contribute to conversations that strengthen brand awareness, credibility, and community engagement. Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, podcasts, and other public-facing opportunities, both online and in person. Gather valuable feedback, questions, and insights from developers and communicate them to engineering and product teams to help inform product improvements. Collaborate with New Media, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, and other internal teams to support product launches and communication initiatives. Help shape the organization's public voice and positioning within the broader developer ecosystem. Requirements: Proven experience in a senior Developer Relations, Developer Advocacy, or similar developer-facing position. An established and engaged Twitter (X) following, with demonstrated credibility and influence within the developer community. Evaluation will consider audience engagement, the quality of interactions, and the relevance of your network, not just follower numbers. Strong technical knowledge and the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, accurately, and engagingly to technical audiences. Excellent writing skills, with a distinctive personal voice and the ability to create compelling, insightful, and relevant content. Confidence and experience representing an organization publicly across social media, video, podcasts, conferences, and industry events. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build authentic relationships and engage effectively with developers and industry professionals. A proactive, self-directed mindset, with strong ownership, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable collaborating across distributed teams and managing priorities in an asynchronous work environment. Benefits: Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world, with no requirement to work from a physical office. Co-working Allowance: Access to a WeWork membership or co-working budget to support your preferred working environment. Equity Ownership (ESOP): Receive company equity and participate in the long-term growth and success of the organization. Technology Allowance: Dedicated budget to purchase equipment and tools, including laptops, monitors, headphones, and other work essentials. Health Insurance: 100% of employee health insurance premiums covered, with 80% coverage for eligible dependents, regardless of location. Annual Company Off-Sites: Join colleagues from around the world for a week of collaboration, networking, and team activities in a different city each year. Flexible Working Arrangements: Enjoy an asynchronous working culture with the autonomy to organize your schedule and manage your responsibilities. Professional Development: Annual learning allowance to invest in courses, books, conferences, and other professional growth opportunities. Global Team Environment: Collaborate with an international team spanning more than 60 countries and 20 languages, within a thriving open-source and developer-focused ecosystem.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead and manage paid advertising campaigns across LinkedIn, Google Ads, Reddit, YouTube, X, and other relevant platforms, focusing on enterprise brand awareness, qualified pipeline generation, and revenue growth. Collaborate with Growth Marketing, Account-Based Marketing, and SEO teams to align campaign strategies, establish optimization priorities, and maximize incremental performance. Monitor campaign performance daily, implementing optimization strategies to improve click-through rates, cost per lead, return on ad spend, and overall marketing efficiency. Develop and maintain a structured performance review process, analyzing weekly results, identifying trends, and translating insights into actionable recommendations. Report bi-weekly to marketing leadership and key stakeholders on budget utilization, campaign performance, pipeline contribution, and return on investment. Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen campaign attribution, tracking accuracy, and data consistency across marketing and sales systems. Build comprehensive revenue attribution reporting, including account-based marketing attribution through advertising platform APIs. Manage advertising budgets, monitor spending and pacing across channels, and ensure resources are allocated effectively to maximize business impact. Identify new advertising platforms, audience segments, targeting strategies, and creative formats to expand reach and drive performance improvements. Develop and manage a monthly experimentation roadmap, coordinating A/B tests and campaign initiatives with relevant internal stakeholders. Own the email marketing program, including one-off campaigns, audience segmentation, and the development and optimization of automated nurture sequences. Lead and support a small performance marketing team, fostering collaboration, accountability, professional development, and strong execution. Work closely with creative, content, and design teams to test messaging, advertising formats, and audience engagement strategies. Requirements: 6–10 years of experience in performance marketing or demand generation, preferably within a B2B SaaS company or a marketing agency. Proven track record of managing annual paid media budgets exceeding $1 million while delivering measurable returns on investment. Extensive hands-on experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns, with familiarity across additional platforms such as Reddit, YouTube, and X. Strong understanding of full-funnel performance marketing strategies, including enterprise demand generation, account-based advertising, lead nurturing, and revenue-focused campaign management. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of major AI initiatives, including AI-powered assistants, contextual data systems, and generative AI features. Contribute directly to production AI systems from the outset, identifying technical opportunities and delivering improvements to existing architecture and workflows. Drive early improvements in AI quality, reliability, and performance by addressing known failure points, strengthening evaluation coverage, and implementing measurable enhancements. Take ownership of major AI projects from architecture and technical planning through cross-functional collaboration, deployment, and ongoing optimization. Define and influence architectural decisions across engineering teams, with particular responsibility for AI architecture and shared platform infrastructure. Establish scalable AI quality frameworks, including automated evaluations, regression testing, guardrails, agent tracing, human feedback mechanisms, and production monitoring. Design and implement reliable AI agents and tool integrations, balancing deterministic code and LLM capabilities while addressing security, latency, reliability, and cost. Drive broader engineering initiatives that improve development quality and velocity, such as AI evaluation standards, agentic software development practices, code review processes, and technical documentation. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, Operations, and engineering stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. Promote engineering excellence through technical mentorship, knowledge sharing, clear architectural standards, and a culture of continuous improvement. Requirements: Extensive experience in software engineering at Staff Engineer or equivalent level, with a proven ability to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives as a hands-on individual contributor. Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying production-grade LLM applications, AI agents, or generative AI features used by real customers. Strong technical leadership skills, including the ability to influence architectural decisions across teams, establish engineering standards, and drive initiatives from proposal through implementation. Proven experience building and maintaining AI evaluation frameworks that combine automated testing, agent traces, human feedback, and production monitoring to measure quality and prevent regressions. Strong understanding of AI agent architecture, tool design, and orchestration, including the ability to determine when deterministic logic is preferable to LLM-based solutions. Experience designing secure and reliable tool boundaries, human-in-the-loop workflows, and systems that balance performance, latency, security, and operational costs. Sound judgment in build-versus-buy decisions, model selection, and AI provider integrations. Strong backend and platform engineering expertise, particularly with Python and Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, asynchronous workers, and REST or GraphQL APIs. Ability to design scalable shared AI infrastructure with well-defined interfaces, efficient caching strategies, and robust tenant isolation. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Design, QA, and engineering teams. A pragmatic, measurement-driven approach to AI development, prioritizing evidence, evaluation, and reliability over simply changing models or rewriting prompts. Benefits: Competitive salary package. Opportunity to build and ship production AI solutions used daily by real customers. Broad technical scope across multiple AI products and the shared infrastructure supporting them. jobs.description: Accountabilities: As a Sleep Test Specialist, you will support patients throughout the at-home sleep testing process, ensuring they receive the guidance and follow-up needed to complete their tests efficiently. Contact patients through phone calls, emails, and SMS to provide clear instructions and guidance on completing their sleep tests. Answer patient questions, address concerns, and resolve obstacles that may prevent successful test completion. Maintain a professional, empathetic, and patient-focused approach in all communications. Proactively follow up with patients who have received their testing kits but have not yet completed their tests. Develop and implement engagement strategies to encourage timely test completion and improve patient participation. Identify reasons for delays or incomplete tests and take appropriate action to address them. Monitor patient progress and track key performance indicators related to test completion and engagement. Maintain accurate records of patient interactions, follow-ups, test statuses, and other relevant information. Identify trends and operational bottlenecks and use performance insights to improve follow-up strategies. Perform data entry, update patient records, assist with appointment scheduling, and handle other administrative responsibilities. Coordinate with clinical, marketing, and internal support teams to ensure consistent communication throughout the patient journey. Collect and share patient feedback, identify recurring challenges, and recommend improvements to the sleep testing experience. Contribute practical ideas and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and overall test completion rates. Requirements: You are a highly organized and proactive professional with strong communication skills and the ability to motivate patients while managing multiple responsibilities in a performance-driven environment. At least 2 years of experience in customer service, administrative support, patient engagement, or a related field. Previous experience in healthcare or direct-to-consumer (DTC) environments is an advantage. Bachelor's degree preferred, although relevant professional experience may be considered. Proven ability to meet or exceed performance targets in a metrics-driven environment. jobs.title: Head of Finance - R&D
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Head of Finance - R&D, you will lead the development and management of the financial infrastructure, treasury operations, and banking partnerships supporting international technology businesses. Your main responsibilities will include: Banking and Payment Infrastructure Design and implement a flexible, multi-jurisdictional banking network for international digital businesses operating under demanding compliance requirements. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard strategic financial partners, including leading banks, Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), Payment Service Providers (PSPs), custodians, and financial platforms. Negotiate favorable commercial terms, including transaction fees, payment terms, foreign exchange rates, and hedging instruments. Establish backup banking relationships and alternative payment channels to ensure uninterrupted transaction processing. Treasury and Liquidity Management Manage multi-currency liquidity, working capital, cash pooling, and treasury operations across a group of legal entities. Oversee complex international transfers through SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, and other payment networks, prioritizing speed, security, and cost efficiency. Monitor and reduce treasury expenses, including FX spreads, acquiring fees, and banking charges. Compliance, KYC, and Regulatory Strategy Coordinate banking due diligence and maintain effective communication with bank compliance and risk teams. Ensure the long-term stability of banking relationships and payment flows. Support financial restructuring, corporate changes, and related banking and compliance requirements. Financial Systems and Executive Partnership Build integrated treasury and financial processes from the ground up. Partner with founders and senior leadership on unit economics, ROI analysis, and financial modeling. Recruit, lead, and develop the treasury and operational finance team. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines senior finance leadership experience with strong expertise in international treasury operations, banking infrastructure, and financial compliance. You should bring: At least 5 years of experience as a CFO, VP of Finance, or Head of Treasury in fast-growing businesses. A proven track record of opening corporate bank accounts and establishing efficient payment processes. Deep knowledge of international AML/KYC principles, cross-border compliance, and regulatory requirements across different jurisdictions. Practical experience managing multi-currency funds, foreign exchange exposure, financial settlement instruments, and transaction cost optimization. Strong negotiation skills and the ability to manage complex relationships with banks, legal advisors, and financial service providers. Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2), with the ability to lead detailed, persuasive negotiations independently. Strong strategic thinking, financial judgment, and the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment. Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with founders and executive stakeholders. Benefits: High level of autonomy: Full ownership of the financial and banking infrastructure, with minimal unnecessary bureaucracy. Meaningful business impact: Direct involvement in launching and scaling new technology businesses serving millions of users. Strong professional environment: Collaboration with experienced founders and talented engineering and marketing professionals. Dedicated platform support: Access to more than 10 specialized teams providing expertise in recruitment, communications, finance, legal matters, and other operational areas. Founder community: Opportunities to exchange practical knowledge and experience with entrepreneurs who have successfully launched multiple businesses. Professional communities: Access to internal groups focused on product, marketing, engineering, and payments. Learning and development: Training programs, professional cou

jobs.title: Deputy CDO
jobs.description: Accountabilities: The Deputy CDO will take ownership of execution across the Research Center, translating strategic priorities into measurable results while ensuring operational excellence, effective resource management, and strong collaboration across teams. Strategic Initiative Leadership: Lead selected strategic initiatives from business case development and prioritization through implementation and measurable business impact. Ensure projects align with organizational objectives and deliver tangible value. Executive Stakeholder Management: Collaborate directly with C-level executives and business leaders to align priorities, negotiate resources and timelines, and manage strategic trade-offs using data-driven arguments and financial insights. Cross-Functional Project Execution: Oversee major initiatives across data and analytics, including data platform development, BigQuery migration, complex machine learning projects, experimentation processes, AI-powered analytics, UX research, and data quality improvements. Project Delivery and Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve delivery bottlenecks across teams. Clarify project scope, assign ownership, establish next steps, address dependencies, and escalate risks early to ensure initiatives progress successfully. Resource and Backlog Management: Manage capacity, resources, and backlogs across multiple teams. Prioritize initiatives according to business value, coordinate dependencies between ML, backend, product, and analytics teams, and reassess or discontinue projects that fail to deliver expected results. Operational Management and Governance: Establish and maintain the operating framework for the Research Center, including monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, project reviews, retrospectives, commitment tracking, escalation procedures, and centralized performance dashboards. Business Impact and ROI Measurement: Translate strategic initiatives into measurable business objectives, expected benefits, and financial outcomes. Monitor ROI and actual performance against plans, ensuring that delivery success is measured by business impact rather than task completion alone. Team Leadership and Development: Support and strengthen team leads across Product Analytics, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and UX Research. Help them define objectives, prioritize work, improve management practices, provide constructive feedback, and develop their leadership capabilities. Operational Performance: Oversee the operational health of the data function, monitoring data freshness, platform uptime, ML infrastructure stability, delivery predictability, and experimentation throughput. Strategic and Organizational Continuity: Act as a trusted partner and successor to the CDO, maintaining the ability to assume responsibility for the entire data function when required. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced data and technology leader with a strong background in product organizations, proven operational execution capabilities, and the ambition to progress into a Chief Data Officer position. At least 7 years of professional experience in data, analytics, or machine learning within product-focused technology companies. At least 4 years of leadership experience managing highly skilled specialists, managers, and team leads. Previous experience as a Chief Data Officer, Deputy CDO, Head of Data, or Head of Analytics within a mid-sized or large product organization is highly desirable. Strong ambition and readiness to grow into a CDO role, combining strategic vision with hands-on responsibility for day-to-day execution. Broad understanding of data and research functions, including product and marketing analytics, A/B testing, experimentation, machine learning lifecycles, data platforms, data quality, service-level agreements (SLAs), business intelligence, self-service analytics, and unit economics. Deep practical expertise in at least one major data domain, supported by the ability to understan

jobs.title: Wearables Marketing Expert
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Develop and execute the go-to-market strategy for the wearables initiative, defining target audiences, product positioning, messaging, pricing recommendations, and launch plans. Translate wearable health metrics, including sleep, heart rate variability (HRV), recovery, and physical activity, into clear customer benefits and compelling marketing messages. Plan, launch, and optimise customer acquisition campaigns targeting wearable owners through paid social channels such as Meta and TikTok, YouTube, influencer partnerships, podcasts, and relevant online communities. Build and manage strategic partnerships and co-marketing initiatives with wearable manufacturers, technology brands, and digital platforms, including integration listings, joint campaigns, product bundles, and affiliate agreements. Lead the end-to-end marketing launch of wearable products, covering pre-orders, waitlists, direct-to-consumer (D2C) channels, marketplaces such as Shopify and Amazon, and device-plus-subscription bundles. Optimise the customer journey from device acquisition to subscription activation, working closely with product teams to improve onboarding, device connection rates, and retention. Conduct ongoing market research and competitor analysis to identify emerging trends, customer needs, market opportunities, and developments across the wearables ecosystem. Define, monitor, and analyse key performance indicators, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), device connection rates, subscription conversion, customer retention, partner-driven installations, and revenue. Provide regular performance updates to executive leadership, translating data into actionable insights and continuously adjusting marketing strategies to maximise growth. Proven experience managing the end-to-end launch of a consumer hardware or wearable product, including strategic planning, pre-orders, marketing assets, distribution channels, and performance evaluation. Strong understanding of the wearables ecosystem and health-related metrics, such as sleep patterns, heart rate variability (HRV), recovery, physical activity, and glucose monitoring. Hands-on expertise in performance marketing across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google, and YouTube, with a solid understanding of CAC, lifetime value (LTV), return on advertising spend (ROAS), and subscription conversion funnels. Previous experience developing strategic partnerships or managing business development initiatives with technology brands, manufacturers, or digital platforms. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset, with the ability to make informed decisions based on performance metrics and measurable results. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with professional fluency in English (C1 level or above). Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, take ownership of projects, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Experience working for a wearable technology or health-tracking company, or with applications integrated into wearable devices, is a strong advantage. Familiarity with hardware-plus-subscription business models, including bundled devices and membership offerings, is desirable. Experience with D2C marketing, Amazon marketplaces, A/B testing, landing page optimisation, and customer acquisition strategies is an additional advantage. An established network within the biohacking, longevity, or quantified-self communities, including creators, podcast hosts, and industry experts, would be beneficial. Knowledge of habit-formation psychology and its application to customer engagement and retention is considered a plus. jobs.title: Innovation Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Own and manage a defined segment of the Innovation and IP pipeline, overseeing initiatives from initial assessment and scoping through execution. Identify, evaluate, and prioritize innovation opportunities in line with strategic objectives and commercial priorities. Translate scientific research, emerging technologies, and external opportunities into compelling value propositions, business cases, and development roadmaps. Lead technology development and applied-service projects, ensuring delivery against agreed milestones, budgets, and readiness criteria. Transform early-stage concepts into structured action plans with clear objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, and decision-making milestones. Coordinate cross-functional teams, including scientific, technical, product, marketing, and commercial stakeholders, to advance projects towards market readiness. Develop and maintain relationships with universities, research institutions, technology partners, consultants, and potential licensees. Monitor and communicate project progress, identifying risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and next steps to ensure effective execution. Demonstrated experience translating scientific research, technologies, or complex technical concepts into applied services, development projects, or commercial opportunities. Professional experience in innovation management, life sciences business development, technology transfer, research commercialisation, licensing, or a comparable field. Strong project management capabilities, with a proven ability to lead complex initiatives from initial concept through successful execution. Solid commercial awareness, strategic judgement, and a proactive, results-oriented mindset. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across scientific, technical, commercial, and legal teams. Ability to work independently, take ownership, make informed decisions, and drive initiatives forward. Professional fluency in English and willingness to travel regularly within Europe. Previous experience in animal nutrition, veterinary science, diagnostics, biomonitoring, university partnerships, technology licensing, or intellectual property management is a strong advantage. Benefits: Full-time position within an international and innovation-driven environment. Europe-based role with the flexibility to work remotely from home. Opportunity to take ownership of meaningful innovation and intellectual property projects. Hands-on involvement in transforming scientific discoveries into commercially viable solutions. Regular opportunities to collaborate with universities, research organisations, technology partners, and multidisciplinary teams across Europe. Professional development through exposure to scientific innovation, technology transfer, business development, and commercialisation activities. Regular European travel, offering opportunities to develop an international professional network.

jobs.title: Freelance Video Editor (M/F/D)

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Act as the primary onboarding contact for new business partners, explaining onboarding requirements, answering questions, and providing clear guidance throughout the entire process. Collect business information, Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation, ownership details, and other required materials in accordance with internal procedures and compliance standards. Review submitted documents and information to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency, proactively following up on missing documents, discrepancies, or additional requirements. Enter and maintain partner information and documentation within the appropriate CRM platforms and internal systems, ensuring records remain accurate and up to date. Collaborate with the Compliance team to coordinate document reviews, respond to additional information requests, manage escalations, and follow each case through to final approval. Monitor the progress of individual onboarding cases, identify potential delays, resolve issues proactively, and keep business partners and internal stakeholders informed. Work closely with Sales, Operations, and Host Success teams to ensure a seamless transition from initial onboarding to ongoing partner support. Handle confidential business and personal information responsibly, following established privacy, data protection, and information security procedures. Identify recurring onboarding challenges and recommend improvements to communication templates, workflows, documentation requirements, and operational processes. Track onboarding activity, completion timelines, outstanding documentation, and case progress to support operational efficiency and reporting. Use digital and AI-powered tools where appropriate to support research, streamline administrative tasks, and improve daily productivity. Requirements: At least 1 year of professional experience in customer onboarding, customer support, account coordination, operations, or a related customer-facing or administrative role. Strong attention to detail, with practical experience reviewing documents, validating customer information, and maintaining accurate records. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain processes and documentation requirements clearly to business owners and other stakeholders. Strong organisational and follow-up abilities, including the capacity to manage multiple onboarding cases, prioritise tasks, and consistently meet deadlines. Familiarity with CRM platforms, document management systems, Microsoft Office, and other standard business productivity tools. Good judgement when handling sensitive and confidential information, with an understanding of when to escalate discrepancies or potential compliance concerns. High levels of self-motivation, accountability, and independence, with the ability to remain productive and organised in a fully remote working environment. Customer-oriented mindset, strong interpersonal skills, and a proactive approach to resolving issues and improving the onboarding experience. Comfort using AI-powered tools to support research, information processing, and everyday productivity is a strong advantage. Previous experience with Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures, business verification, or customer due diligence is considered a plus. Experience supporting business customers within financial services, fintech, payment solutions, or cryptocurrency environments is an additional advantage. Familiarity with business registration documents, company ownership structures, and related verification requirements is beneficial. Candidates must currently reside in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe to be eligible for this fully remote opportunity. jobs.title: Customer Retention Supervisor
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards. Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example. Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance. Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement. Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives. Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered. Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills. Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies. Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports. Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution. Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team. Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity. Requirements: At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment. Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results. Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials. Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement. Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans. Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms. Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards. Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage. Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus. Benefits: Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location. Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance. Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year. Public Holidays: Paid time off on all U.
