jobs.title: Channel Account Manager
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Channel Account Manager based in Romania. We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Channel Account Manager to build and develop a strong partner ecosystem across the EMEA region. This is an exciting opportunity to shape a channel strategy from the ground up, identifying the right partners and establishing the programs and processes needed for long-term success. You will work closely with regional go-to-market and sales teams to turn partnerships into sustainable sources of pipeline and revenue. The role combines partner recruitment, relationship management, business development, and joint selling. You will collaborate with resellers, distributors, managed service providers, and system integrators operating in the DevOps, cloud, and cybersecurity markets. Ideal for a commercially driven professional who enjoys building relationships and creating impact in a fast-paced technology environment. Accountabilities: Identify, recruit, onboard, and develop strategic channel partners across EMEA, including resellers, distributors, MSPs, MSSPs, and regional system integrators with strong DevOps, cloud, and security expertise. Develop joint business plans with key partners and drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue. Train partner sales and technical teams, working alongside Sales Engineers to enable them to independently position, demonstrate, and sell the solutions. Collaborate with account executives throughout the sales cycle, supporting partner-led opportunities from initial meetings through negotiation and deal closure. Establish and improve the foundations of the partner program, including partner tiers, deal registration, engagement rules, discounts, and margin structures. Coordinate joint marketing initiatives with partners, including events, workshops, and campaigns, in collaboration with the marketing team. Work with the Alliances team to support partner opportunities through AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud marketplaces. Maintain accurate partner activity and pipeline information in Salesforce and provide regular performance updates. Share partner and customer insights with Product, Pricing, and leadership teams to help inform business and product decisions. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in channel sales, partner management, or partner development within B2B software, ideally in DevOps, cloud, or cybersecurity. Practical experience working with resellers, distributors, MSPs, MSSPs, and regional system integrators, with a track record of generating partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue. An established network of partner relationships across EMEA and the ability to build trusted, productive partnerships throughout the region. Strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different levels. Proven ability to collaborate closely with direct sales teams and support co-selling activities. Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or similar frameworks. Understanding of software supply chain security or container security is an advantage. Knowledge of relevant European regulations, including NIS2, DORA, and the Cyber Resilience Act, is a strong plus. Excellent organizational skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to work independently while building new processes in a fast-growing startup environment. Benefits: Opportunity to establish and shape an EMEA partner ecosystem from the ground up. Exposure to a broad network of technology partners across the DevOps, cloud, and cybersecurity sectors. Close collaboration with regional sales, go-to-market, alliances, marketing, product, and leadership teams. Opportunity to influence channel strategy, partner programs, and business growth across EMEA.

Build relationships and engage confidently with C-level executives, business owners, founders, and other senior decision-makers. Present and demonstrate AI solutions, clearly communicating their value, practical applications, and commercial benefits. Excellent spoken and written English, with outstanding communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Strong commercial awareness and the confidence and charisma to influence senior executives and key decision-makers. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Edge - Networking & Fleet)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Scale the existing data plane by evolving the command-and-control service into a horizontally scalable fetch scheduler capable of handling 50–100 million requests per day. Design and build the Fleet Manager control plane, including provider adapters, inventory and health management, configuration, reconciliation, software rollout control, and metrics export to BigQuery. Develop provider integrations that allow additional device sources to be onboarded through standardized workflows rather than bespoke scripts. Own and improve the CONNECT proxy gateway, edge session management, IP reputation, proxy leases, and request scheduling in collaboration with other engineering teams. Engineer secure and reliable networking between control services and residential peers using mTLS, gRPC, long-polling, and streaming over unreliable connections. Address networking challenges involving NAT, carrier-grade NAT, bandwidth accounting, connection reliability, and resource contention. Define and maintain service-level objectives for availability, request success, and latency across the Edge route. Build observability and operational metrics covering peer availability, device drop-off, bandwidth usage, and provider performance. Implement safe blue/green deployments and software rollouts for control services and edge peers. Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident post-mortems, and translate operational findings into improvements. Produce technical design documents and recommendations for scheduling, fleet management, and failover strategies. Review technical designs and promote distributed-systems best practices, including consistency, backpressure, idempotency, and limiting failure impact. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional Rust experience, including building, deploying, and operating production services end to end. Demonstrated experience designing and operating distributed systems, such as schedulers, control planes, or stateful services at scale. Strong understanding of distributed-systems concepts, including consistency, network partitions, backpressure, and idempotency. Deep networking knowledge covering TCP, TLS, HTTP, connection handshakes, and packet-level behavior. Practical experience with gRPC and long-lived connections across NAT environments and unreliable networks. Experience building or operating forward proxies, proxy gateways, or residential/ISP proxy infrastructure. Understanding of IP reputation, session stickiness, proxy pool health, and traffic routing. Production operations experience, including defining SLOs and error budgets, building observability, leading incident response, and participating in on-call rotations. Familiarity with cross-platform Rust development targeting Windows, Linux, and Android, including foreign function interface (FFI) boundaries where needed. Strong written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within a globally distributed, remote-first team. Curiosity, analytical thinking, and a practical approach to investigating system behavior under load and resolving underlying causes. Technical environment: Languages: Rust (Tokio, Tonic), C++ (Cronet), Python, and Java. Protocols: gRPC, Protocol Buffers, mTLS, HTTP CONNECT, Chromium networking stack, and browserless HTTP clients. jobs.title: Senior Architect, Enterprise Agentic Automation
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own end-to-end delivery of agentic automation initiatives, from business discovery and solution design through production deployment and value realization. Lead discovery workshops with process owners to assess existing workflows, establish baselines, and define target processes. Determine how AI agents, business rules, and human intervention should be orchestrated across each process. Translate target processes into actionable engineering requirements, including epics, scenarios, acceptance criteria, and delivery increments. Design enterprise solutions aligned with the established reference architecture, introducing new patterns and approaches where appropriate. Coordinate technical delivery with engineers, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and decisions throughout implementation. Maintain alignment with stakeholders and sponsors, communicate progress, and ensure timely business decisions. Define and monitor measurable value for each initiative and delivery increment. Incorporate delivery insights into the reference architecture, implementation methodology, and ongoing product improvements. Requirements: At least 7 years of experience in solution architecture or technical/process consulting, supported by an engineering background such as Java, JavaScript, or a comparable technology. Significant experience delivering technical solutions for business stakeholders or customers. Proven track record leading process orchestration initiatives from discovery through production, rather than handing over designs after the architecture phase. Strong business analysis and process management capabilities, including facilitating discovery and process redesign workshops. Practical experience modeling business processes using BPMN and translating process requirements into robust solution designs. Experience with enterprise solution and data architecture, including integrations, APIs, and the data required by processes and AI agents across systems. An AI-first mindset, with initial experience designing and building enterprise-grade agentic solutions. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive decisions. Willingness and ability to learn and use the partner company's product and platform. Nice to have: Experience in Finance, back-office operations, or related process domains, including Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Quote-to-Cash (Q2C). Experience developing value cases using operational data, including process baselines, volumes, value estimates, and benefits tracking. Familiarity with value engineering, process intelligence, or process mining tools. Working knowledge of enterprise platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, or Zip. jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead (User Acquisition)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Plan, execute, manage, and optimize paid user acquisition campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, and other relevant advertising platforms. Manage and allocate significant advertising budgets based on key performance indicators, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS), customer lifetime value (LTV), and payback periods. Monitor and analyze campaign performance, conversion funnels, and user cohorts to identify opportunities for improving acquisition efficiency and overall profitability. Design and implement structured experiments across audience segments, bidding strategies, landing pages, and creative formats to improve conversion rates and reduce acquisition costs. Collaborate closely with creative and marketing teams to develop, test, and refine advertising concepts, messaging, and formats using performance insights to guide creative production. Measure and evaluate acquisition effectiveness through attribution platforms, cohort analysis, and incrementality testing. Develop and execute user acquisition strategies across multiple markets, identifying opportunities to expand campaigns and reach new audiences. Scale successful campaigns while maintaining acquisition costs and profitability within established business targets. Make data-driven decisions regarding campaign optimization, budget distribution, audience targeting, and channel performance. Take direct ownership of campaign execution and continuous improvement, ensuring marketing investments generate measurable and sustainable business results. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in performance marketing, digital advertising, or user acquisition, ideally within mobile gaming or consumer mobile applications. Proven hands-on experience planning, managing, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, and AppLovin. Demonstrated ability to manage substantial advertising budgets and scale acquisition campaigns while consistently meeting customer acquisition cost and profitability objectives. Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics and methodologies, including CAC, ROAS, LTV, cohort analysis, attribution models, and payback periods. Practical experience with mobile measurement and attribution platforms such as AppsFlyer or Adjust. Experience designing and executing creative testing strategies, interpreting results, and using performance insights to improve advertising effectiveness. Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret campaign-level and user-level data, identify performance challenges, and make informed budget allocation decisions. A proven track record of personally managing and optimizing acquisition campaigns rather than focusing exclusively on agency coordination or high-level strategy. Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across creative, marketing, and other business teams. A results-oriented mindset, strong commercial awareness, and the ability to balance growth ambitions with acquisition efficiency and long-term profitability. Nice-to-have qualifications: Experience scaling user acquisition campaigns within the mobile gaming industry. Previous responsibility for managing paid acquisition strategies across multiple countries and international markets. Familiarity with incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and advanced attribution methodologies. Experience acquiring customers for fintech, insurance, financial services, or other consumer financial products. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, offering the flexibility to work from different locations. Full-time opportunity within an international and multicultural working environment. Opportunity to contribute to the growth of innovative, next-generation digital and financial products. Exposure to large-scale user acquisition campaigns and substantial advertising

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Edge - Devices & Mobile)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Design, develop, and maintain a cross-platform Rust peer runtime supporting Windows, Android, and Linux, with future compatibility for macOS. Manage process lifecycles, background execution, networking, automatic updates, and operational stability across diverse and unmanaged hardware environments. Lead the expansion of the platform to Android devices using NDK and JNI, addressing foreground services, battery optimization, mobile network constraints, and integration with real and emulated device environments. Integrate native networking technologies, including Chromium's network stack (Cronet and C++), and browserless HTTP clients into well-structured, reliable Rust libraries. Work with native operating system APIs and foreign function interfaces (FFI), ensuring safe memory management, ownership, and cross-language interoperability. Collect and analyze hardware and operating system signals, including TCP, TLS, and HTTP fingerprints, to improve network realism and support collaboration with browser and anti-detection engineering teams. Develop comprehensive device-level observability and performance metrics, monitoring uptime, bandwidth consumption, device availability, drop-off rates, and task success rates. Expand peer capabilities to support additional workloads, including CAPTCHA solving and browser rendering, while maintaining strong security boundaries around untrusted content and environments. Participate in on-call rotations, investigate production incidents, conduct post-mortems, and implement improvements to system reliability and deployment processes. Contribute to technical documentation, architecture proposals, design reviews, and engineering standards, helping establish best practices for cross-platform Rust development. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience developing, shipping, and maintaining production-grade software using Rust. Proven experience building and deploying cross-platform Rust applications on at least two operating systems among Windows, macOS, and Android, including experience with at least one mobile platform. Strong understanding of operating system internals, process management, permissions, background execution, and platform-specific constraints. Hands-on experience with FFI and integrating Rust with C/C++ libraries and native operating system APIs, including JNI/NDK, Win32, and POSIX interfaces. Solid knowledge of networking protocols, particularly TCP, TLS, and HTTP, with the ability to inspect network traffic, understand protocol-level behavior, and analyze client fingerprint differences. Experience with asynchronous programming and networking in Rust, ideally using technologies such as Tokio and Tonic. Strong focus on software reliability, observability, performance monitoring, and production operations, including the ability to measure and troubleshoot distributed device fleets remotely. Good understanding of secure software design, particularly when deploying and operating software on third-party devices and environments. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within a globally distributed, remote-first engineering team. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with intellectual curiosity and an interest in reverse engineering, networking technologies, and complex systems. Familiarity with technologies such as gRPC, Protocol Buffers, mutual TLS (mTLS), Chromium networking, Kotlin, Java, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure is advantageous. Nice-to-have qualifications: Experience developing or operating residential proxy networks, peer-to-peer applications, or large-scale device farms. Knowledge of browser internals and networking technologies such as Chromium, Cronet, Firefox networking, or anti-detection techniques. Background in distributed systems, particularly schedulers, orchestration platforms, control planes, and large-scale infrastructure. Familia

jobs.title: VP Global Demand & Delivery

Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with forecasting models, planning tools, data analysis, and performance reporting. jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Designer based in Romania. The Product Designer will shape intuitive, engaging, and visually polished digital experiences for a fast-growing AI-powered consumer technology product used by millions of people worldwide. This role spans mobile and web applications, with a focus on improving customer journeys, developing new features, and creating seamless interactive experiences. Working closely with product managers and engineers, you will lead design initiatives from early concepts and prototypes through to final implementation. You will combine strong visual instincts with user-centered product thinking to deliver experiences that are both functional and delightful. This is an opportunity to influence a high-impact consumer product in a dynamic, collaborative, and fast-moving environment. Accountabilities: Design intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling user experiences across mobile and web applications. Create and optimize customer journeys, including onboarding flows, everyday interactions, and new product features. Translate product requirements and user needs into wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs. Own design projects end-to-end, from initial concepts and exploration through implementation and delivery. Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to ensure high-quality product experiences. Use user feedback, research findings, and product analytics to identify opportunities for improvement. Contribute to the creation, maintenance, and evolution of the product design system. Ensure consistency, usability, accessibility, and visual quality across different product experiences. Stay informed about emerging design trends, technologies, and best practices in consumer product design. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in Product Design, UX/UI Design, or a related role. Proven experience designing mobile and web products in B2C environments, ideally for products with large user bases. A strong portfolio demonstrating visual design expertise, product thinking, and exceptional attention to detail. Experience creating polished, intuitive, and user-friendly digital applications. Monitor key performance indicators, including service levels, availability, handling times, and workforce utilization. Analyze operational data and translate performance insights into actionable recommendations. Develop and optimize reporting systems to improve operational visibility and decision-making. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure effective resource allocation and smooth day-to-day operations. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include: Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities. Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems. Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes. Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking. Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements. Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback. Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements. Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred. Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences. jobs.title: i2nd Level Supporter - E-banking
jobs.description: Accountabilities: In this role, you will oversee second-level technical support for digital banking services, ensuring that customer issues are investigated and resolved effectively. Your responsibilities will include: Provide technical second-level support for digital services and e-banking platforms. Analyze, troubleshoot, isolate, and resolve technical incidents affecting banking applications and related services. Manage incident and problem tickets, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution. Provide telephone-based customer assistance in both German and French. Handle support requests through telephone, email, and remote-access tools while adhering to established processes and service-level agreements (SLAs). Prioritize, classify, and coordinate incidents according to their urgency and technical complexity. Escalate unresolved or complex issues to internal specialist teams or third-level support when necessary. Collaborate with internal departments, technology vendors, and internet service providers to identify and implement appropriate solutions. Maintain accurate documentation of support cases, technical investigations, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions. Contribute to the continuous improvement of support processes, workflows, and technical tools. Requirements The ideal candidate combines solid technical troubleshooting expertise with strong customer service skills and the ability to manage complex support situations independently. The following qualifications and competencies are expected: Several years of experience in technical customer support, ideally in a second-level support role. Strong knowledge of hardware and operating systems, including Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Good to very good understanding of IT security, Identity and Access Management (IAM) technologies, two-factor and multi-factor authentication (2FA/MFA), and directory services. Good knowledge of antivirus software, firewalls, and networking technologies, including LAN/WLAN, TCP/IP, routers, and modems. Experience with structured troubleshooting, log analysis, remote-support tools, and ticketing systems. Familiarity with various products and services offered by internet service providers. Strong customer orientation and communication skills, including the ability to handle demanding customer situations professionally. Ability to work independently, systematically, and accurately while managing multiple support requests. Strong teamwork, resilience, flexibility, and willingness to continuously learn and develop technical expertise. Very good command of both German and French. Knowledge of Italian and English is considered an advantage. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world. Freelance Opportunity: Independent contractor engagement offering a flexible professional arrangement. International Work Environment: Collaborate with internal specialists and external technology partners. Technical Exposure: Work with digital banking platforms, IT security technologies, identity management solutions, and modern support tools. Professional Development: Strengthen your technical troubleshooting, incident management, and customer support expertise. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work alongside different technical teams and service providers to solve complex issues. Process Improvement: Contribute directly to the optimization of support workflows, tools, and service quality. Immediate Availability: The assignment is expected to start as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Billing Support Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: In this role, you will take ownership of customer billing inquiries while collaborating with technical and business teams to improve support operations. Your main responsibilities will include: Provide timely initial responses to customer support requests covering billing questions, pre-sales inquiries, usage optimization, and payment disputes. Investigate and troubleshoot customer-specific billing issues, including failed payments, outstanding invoices, and payment extension requests. Triage incoming support cases and guide customers toward relevant documentation, previous solutions, code examples, and technical resources. Escalate complex issues to the appropriate engineering or business teams when additional expertise or intervention is required. Identify opportunities to develop, adopt, or improve internal tools that increase support efficiency and streamline workflows. Recognize recurring customer issues and share insights that can contribute to product improvements and better billing experiences. Reproduce technical issues and create test cases to support troubleshooting and improve test coverage, where applicable. Collaborate with the Billing Engineering team and other stakeholders to ensure effective communication and resolution of customer concerns. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced customer support professional with a strong understanding of billing processes and the ability to communicate effectively with technical customers. The following qualifications and skills are expected: At least 2 years of experience in customer support, including providing billing support to technical customers. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English. Ability to explain technical concepts and billing-related issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working with asynchronous communication practices and globally distributed teams. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify appropriate solutions. Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple support cases while maintaining responsiveness and attention to detail. Familiarity with SQL is considered a plus. Experience reproducing technical issues, creating test cases, or improving test coverage is an additional advantage. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world, with a WeWork membership or co-working allowance to support your preferred working environment. Equity Ownership (ESOP): Receive company equity so you can share in the organization's long-term growth and success. Technology Allowance: Access a dedicated budget to purchase equipment such as a laptop, monitor, headphones, and other tools needed to work effectively. Health Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance coverage, with 100% of employee premiums and 80% of dependent premiums covered, regardless of location. Annual Team Off-Sites: Participate in yearly company-wide gatherings in a different city, offering opportunities for collaboration, connection, and team building. Flexible Working Arrangements: Benefit from an asynchronous work culture that gives you autonomy over your schedule and daily priorities. Professional Development: Receive an annual education allowance to invest in courses, books, conferences, and other learning opportunities.

jobs.title: Sales Manager B2B - (freelance)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Actively promote and sell software solutions and professional consulting services to business customers across the German market. Identify, approach, and acquire new B2B customers while maintaining and expanding relationships with existing accounts. Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and prospect qualification to negotiations and contract closure. Coordinate with product teams, sales specialists, and relevant internal stakeholders throughout the sales process. Develop and implement sales strategies aligned with business objectives and market expansion plans. Take ownership of revenue targets and sales performance within the assigned customer segment. Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, monitor opportunities, and maintain accurate CRM records. Identify customer needs and present relevant software and consulting solutions in a compelling, value-driven manner. Represent the business at trade fairs, industry events, professional conferences, and networking opportunities. Monitor sales performance and relevant KPIs to identify opportunities for improvement and support sustainable revenue growth. jobs.title: Full-Cycle Psychiatric Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Support full-cycle psychiatric and behavioral health medical billing, including claims management, payment posting, accounts receivable, and collections. Review claims, patient balances, billing records, and outstanding account issues to ensure accuracy and timely resolution. Investigate rejected, denied, or underpaid claims and assist with corrections, resubmissions, and appeals. Maintain accurate payment records, accounts receivable information, collection notes, and patient account updates. Apply relevant ICD-10 and CPT codes, payer guidelines, and psychiatric billing requirements when reviewing and processing billing information. Use eClinicalWorks (eCW) to navigate patient accounts, review claims and balances, generate patient statements, and access billing reports. Follow established procedures for claim corrections, account adjustments, insurance follow-up, and billing documentation. Respond to patient billing inquiries and communicate with insurance representatives regarding claims, balances, and payment status. Explain patient statements, copayments, deductibles, outstanding balances, and routine billing questions clearly and professionally. Follow up on outstanding patient balances and approved payment arrangements. Verify patient identity before discussing protected health information and handle sensitive financial and medical information in accordance with privacy requirements. Communicate calmly and empathetically with frustrated or distressed patients, escalating complex or disputed billing matters when appropriate. Prepare and review accounts receivable, claims, payment, and billing performance reports. Extract, organize, and analyze billing information using Microsoft Excel and other approved reporting tools. Identify discrepancies, overdue balances, and unresolved claims requiring further attention. Coordinate with the practice manager, administrative staff, and external billing providers to maintain efficient workflows. Participate in relevant billing meetings, follow up on assigned action items, and apply training updates accurately. Maintain clear documentation of billing activities, account updates, outstanding issues, and changes to established processes. Meet agreed service timelines, deliverables, communication standards, and other requirements defined in the independent contractor agreement. Requirements: At least 2–3 years of hands-on medical billing and full-cycle revenue cycle management experience . Recent experience in psychiatric, behavioral health, or mental health billing is required and strongly preferred. Demonstrated hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) billing functions. Experience managing both patient-related and insurance-related billing matters. Practical knowledge of Medicare Part B billing requirements. Strong understanding of psychiatric CPT and ICD-10 codes, payer requirements, and behavioral health billing processes. Knowledge of HIPAA requirements, supported by documented training or certification. Experience with payment posting, claim denials, accounts receivable follow-up, and collections. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, particularly for revenue cycle reporting and organizing billing data. Excellent spoken and written English, with strong communication skills for interacting with patients and insurance representatives. A native or near-native level of English is required. Familiarity with electronic claims systems, payer portals, medical billing and reporting tools, email platforms, and business communication applications. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace. Strong technical reliability and the ability to work consistently in a remote environment. Excellent attention to detail, organization, and accuracy when handling patient financial information. Ability to work independently, learn new procedures quickly, retain instructions, and apply feedback effectively. Professional phone etiquette, active listening skills, and the ab

jobs.title: Technical Lead (Ruby on Rails, AI-Native)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Establish and maintain a strong engineering culture, defining how the development team collaborates, communicates, and approaches technical challenges. Set and uphold technical standards for code quality, maintainability, reliability, and consistency across the development environment. jobs.title: Monteur Vidéo Freelance - Business, Fitgame et Spiritualité
jobs.description: Accountabilities: You will manage the editing workflow for personal content across multiple platforms, transforming raw footage into polished, engaging videos while maintaining a consistent publishing schedule. Edit weekly long-form YouTube podcast episodes, creating clear, engaging, and well-paced content. Produce YouTube vlogs featuring everyday life, experiences in Bali, bodybuilding preparation, gym sessions, and personal reflections. Repurpose long-form content into short videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Review and organize large volumes of raw footage, identifying the most compelling moments and strongest emotional sequences. Build engaging narratives from unstructured footage, creating coherent storytelling arcs that maintain viewer interest. Use effective hooks, pacing, subtitles, music, and transitions to strengthen audience engagement. Adapt editing choices to different moods and subjects, moving naturally between fitness motivation, entrepreneurship, lifestyle, and introspective content. Maintain a simple, clean, and consistent editing style that prioritizes clarity and storytelling over unnecessary visual effects. Collaborate directly with the content creator to develop a recognizable creative direction and refine the editing approach over time. Initially deliver approximately one YouTube video per week and one short-form video per day, with the possibility of increasing production to two or more YouTube videos weekly and additional short-form content as the collaboration develops. Meet agreed deadlines and maintain a reliable, consistent production workflow. Requirements The ideal candidate combines practical video editing skills with strong storytelling instincts and a genuine interest in the content themes. Human compatibility and shared interests are particularly important for this long-term collaboration. Proven experience editing video content for YouTube and social media platforms. Strong storytelling abilities, with the capacity to identify key moments in raw footage and turn them into compelling narratives. Experience editing both long-form content, such as podcasts and vlogs, and short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Good understanding of short-form content formats, including hooks, pacing, subtitles, and audience retention. Ability to create clean, effective edits without relying on excessive effects or overly complex visual treatments. Strong sense of rhythm, music selection, and emotional pacing, with the flexibility to work across different musical styles, including metal and techno. Genuine interest in entrepreneurship, bodybuilding, fitness, and spirituality. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate closely with a content creator. Reliability, consistency, autonomy, and good time-management skills. Comfortable working independently in a fully remote freelance arrangement while respecting agreed deadlines. A proactive mindset and willingness to contribute ideas that improve storytelling and content quality. Benefits Fully remote freelance collaboration, open to candidates worldwide. Long-term partnership rather than a one-off project. Regular, recurring workload with a fixed number of working days per week. Stable and recurring compensation, with the amount and payment structure to be agreed upon. Potential arrangements include a monthly retainer, per-video rate, or daily rate. Flexible working arrangements and freedom to organize your schedule, provided deadlines are met. Opportunity to help shape the editing style and storytelling approach from the beginning. Potential to increase workload and compensation as content production grows. Possibility of future involvement in filming and content creation in Bali, depending on mutual interest and availability. Initial workload of approximately 24 hours per week under a 12-month freelance contract, with room for development as the collaboration evolves.

jobs.title: Evaluation Consultant
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Depending on assignment requirements and areas of expertise, you will lead or support evaluation activities, evidence-generation initiatives, and capacity-building efforts under the guidance of the oversight function. Lead evaluation assignments from inception and design through implementation, analysis, and final reporting. Conduct centralized evaluations commissioned and managed by the oversight function, ensuring independence, objectivity, and methodological rigor. Provide technical guidance and quality assurance for decentralized evaluations commissioned by internal organizational units. Review evaluation terms of reference, inception reports, and draft reports, providing recommendations to strengthen quality and alignment with established evaluation standards. Conduct ex post quality assessments of completed evaluations. Design and implement evidence-generation activities, including rapid assessments, reviews, assessments, syntheses, and project or program evaluations. Provide technical support on evaluability, evaluation design, resource planning, theories of change, and evidence-generation methodologies. Prepare evaluation inception reports outlining the proposed methodology, scope, and implementation approach. Draft evaluation reports presenting clear findings, conclusions, and actionable recommendations. Produce concise evaluation briefs that communicate key insights and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. Develop capacity-building materials, practical tools, and guidance covering theories of change, evaluation methods, evaluation management, and effective stakeholder engagement. Contribute to awareness and learning activities that strengthen organizational evaluation practices and promote the use of evidence in decision-making. Identify evaluation risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies to support effective implementation and the practical use of findings. Requirements Candidates should have a relevant academic background and practical experience in evaluation, research, or evidence generation. Applications are particularly encouraged from professionals with expertise in digital development, telecommunications, institutional effectiveness, and related thematic areas. University degree in Development Studies, International Development, Social Sciences, Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs), Telecommunications, or a related field. An equivalent diploma from a recognized institution of advanced education may also be accepted. Evaluation-related certification is an advantage. At least 2 years of professional experience in a field relevant to the specific assignment. Experience conducting different types of evaluations, including strategy, policy, process, outcome, theory-based, realist, program, and project evaluations. Familiarity with evaluation approaches such as mid-range theories, adaptive methods, rapid assessments, reviews, value-for-money assessments, evidence syntheses, segmentation analysis, and mid-term assessments. Ability to design evaluation methodologies, analyze evidence, formulate conclusions, and develop practical recommendations. Strong report-writing and communication skills, including the ability to produce clear evaluation reports, concise briefs, and capacity-building materials. Advanced proficiency in English. Knowledge of at least one additional official language of the international organization, such as Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, or Spanish, is an advantage. Previous experience working within the United Nations system is an advantage. Relevant thematic expertise may include: Institutional mechanisms and organizational effectiveness. Digital-sector standards, regulations, and policies. Digital access, inclusion, services, and digitalization. Telecommunications, satellite markets, and digital infrastructure. Network development and the digital economy. Marketing and market analysis. Diversity, inclusion, gender equality, human rights, parti

jobs.title: Europe Margin Expansion and Analytics Leader
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead and execute the European Services margin expansion strategy, identifying opportunities to improve profitability, productivity, and cost management. Drive cross-functional initiatives to reduce margin erosion and improve financial performance across outage costs, capital parts, non-capital parts (NCP), and other covered maintenance costs. Develop and implement recovery plans to address identified financial and operational risks, ensuring alignment and timely execution with business leaders. Establish effective operating rhythms, standardized processes, and accountability frameworks to deliver sustainable performance improvements. Act as the regional focal point for cost governance, strengthening cost visibility, financial transparency, and operational discipline. Collaborate with Finance, Operations, regional leadership, and commercial teams to improve cost productivity and optimize business performance. Lead detailed financial and operational analyses to identify root causes, quantify business impact, and implement measurable corrective actions. Promote best practices and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, productivity, and profitability. Define and lead the regional analytics strategy, ensuring consistent KPI measurement, reporting, and performance monitoring. Develop and maintain dashboards, business intelligence tools, and visual management solutions that provide leadership with timely and actionable insights. Translate complex financial and operational datasets into clear recommendations and compelling performance narratives for senior management. Identify emerging trends, anomalies, risks, opportunities, and predictive indicators to support proactive business planning and decision-making. Build scalable analytical frameworks that improve forecasting, operational visibility, and resource planning. Champion the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across Services Operations, identifying opportunities to leverage Generative AI, intelligent agents, machine learning, and automation. jobs.title: Producer / Head of Studio
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Own the end-to-end production pipeline: Oversee the complete lifecycle of all slot game projects, from initial concept and planning through development, certification, market launch and post-launch optimisation. Shape the game portfolio: Define and manage the studio's game development slate, identifying themes, features and mechanics that appeal to players in US online and land-based gaming markets. Lead licensed and branded content production: Manage the development of branded slot titles, coordinate relationships with licensors and oversee brand approval processes to ensure all deliverables meet agreed requirements. Manage multidisciplinary teams: Coordinate and lead cross-functional workstreams involving game designers, mathematicians, artists, audio specialists, engineers, QA professionals and compliance teams. Establish production standards: Develop and implement effective production methodologies, documentation processes, quality assurance standards and operational best practices. Monitor regulatory developments: Stay informed about gaming regulations across US states and Canadian provinces, ensuring that production decisions, game features and content remain aligned with market requirements. Drive team development: Recruit, manage, mentor and develop talent across different disciplines, building a high-performing team as the studio expands. Optimise commercial performance: Analyse game performance data and key performance indicators to inform creative decisions, improve game mechanics and maximise the commercial success of published titles. Manage external partnerships: Collaborate effectively with platform providers, B2B aggregators and other industry partners to support successful game distribution and delivery. Requirements: Professional experience: At least 7 years of experience in online slot game production, with a proven track record of successfully delivering multiple titles to market. US market expertise: Demonstrable experience producing online slot content for regulated US gaming markets, with a strong understanding of their commercial and regulatory requirements. Licensed content production: Previous experience managing branded or licensed slot game projects, including licensor relationships, intellectual property requirements and approval workflows. Game mechanics expertise: In-depth knowledge of online and land-based slot game mechanics, including hold-and-spin features, linked progressives and other popular gameplay formats. Analytical capabilities: Ability to interpret game performance data, commercial KPIs and player engagement metrics to guide creative and production decisions. Leadership experience: Proven ability to manage and lead multidisciplinary game development teams, coordinate complex projects and deliver results across multiple functions. Mathematical knowledge: Strong understanding of slot game mathematics, including paytable structures, Return to Player (RTP) calculations and volatility profiles, with the ability to review and assess game mathematics. Industry partnerships: Familiarity with B2B aggregators, game distribution models and platform partners such as Light & Wonder. Additional market experience: Direct experience producing slot content for US land-based casinos or tribal gaming markets is a strong advantage. Production methodologies: Knowledge of game localisation processes, international content adaptation and agile production methodologies is preferred. Leadership qualities: Strong communication, organisational and decision-making skills, combined with a strategic mindset, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead strategic initiatives: Take ownership of two to three high-priority company projects each quarter, managing them from initial planning through execution and delivery. Drive cross-functional programmes: Design, coordinate and deliver major initiatives, including supplier sourcing programmes, operational improvements and AI-enabled workflows. Structure complex challenges: Translate ambiguous questions and strategic priorities from leadership, board members and partners into clearly defined problems, actionable recommendations and execution plans. Manage business operations: Oversee the company's operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, board and investor updates, OKR reviews and all-hands meetings, ensuring decisions translate into measurable progress. Support executive relationships: Represent the CEO in meetings with procurement leaders, strategic partners, cooperative executives and investors, maintaining strong professional relationships and ensuring effective communication. Leverage AI-driven tools: Integrate AI tools, agents and automated workflows into everyday operations to improve productivity, streamline processes and support better decision-making. Coordinate distributed teams: Work closely with colleagues and external stakeholders across the UK and US, ensuring priorities remain aligned and projects progress effectively across time zones. Requirements: Professional experience: 3–5 years of experience following a career in management consulting, ideally at a top-tier consulting firm, or equivalent experience in an operational role at a Series A to C startup. Proven ownership: Demonstrated experience independently managing complex cross-functional projects, business launches or strategic initiatives from initial brief to successful completion. Strategic and analytical thinking: Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to structure ambiguous challenges, develop hypotheses, evaluate options and formulate clear recommendations. Executive communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage senior executives, investors, government stakeholders and external partners. Operational expertise: Experience managing multiple priorities, coordinating stakeholders and maintaining execution momentum within fast-paced, distributed environments. Analytical capabilities: Strong numerical and analytical skills, including practical experience with spreadsheets, dashboards and SQL-related tools. AI proficiency: Hands-on experience using AI-powered tools, agents, MCP servers or prompt-based workflows to improve personal productivity and business operations. International collaboration: Ability to work effectively across different time zones, with strong organisational skills and a structured approach to asynchronous communication. Personal attributes: A proactive, curious and low-ego mindset, combined with high standards, adaptability, sound judgement and the ability to receive and act on feedback. Industry interest: Genuine curiosity about public sector innovation, government procurement and technology-driven transformation. Previous experience in government, cooperative purchasing or regulated B2B markets is an advantage but not essential. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Attractive salary package based on experience and qualifications. Equity participation: Meaningful equity offering, providing an opportunity to share in the company's long-term growth. jobs.title: Long-Form Content Writer (AEO/SEO)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Design, manage, and continuously improve AI-powered workflows and agent systems for content research, drafting, editing, and refreshing. Produce and deliver high-quality, publish-ready long-form articles of at least 1,500 words at a consistent and scalable pace. Optimize existing content for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Search Engine Optimization (SEO), including answer-first introductions, FAQ sections, structured headings, schema-ready formatting, internal linking, and metadata. Ensure the accuracy, credibility, and reliability of all published content by verifying sources, checking facts, and removing unsupported or unverifiable claims. Use search performance and visibility data to identify content opportunities, prioritize existing articles for updates, and organize refresh activities into efficient batches. Develop and implement repeatable batch-refresh workflows that can be adopted and used effectively by other team members. Monitor content performance across Google and AI-powered answer engines, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Track workflow efficiency, production output, editorial quality, and accuracy to continuously improve the content creation process. Deliver measurable results through increased content production, improved search visibility, and stronger AI answer engine citations. Requirements: Proven experience in long-form content writing, content optimization, SEO, and/or AEO, with a portfolio demonstrating published work. Strong hands-on experience using AI tools and agents for research, content generation, editing, and optimization. Candidates should be comfortable designing and operating their own AI workflows rather than simply using basic AI writing assistants. Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality articles of 1,500 words or more while maintaining consistency, accuracy, and editorial standards at scale. Practical knowledge of traditional SEO and emerging AEO strategies, including search intent, answer-first content structures, FAQs, schema-ready formatting, internal linking, and content optimization for AI-generated answers. Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, ClickFlow, or comparable SEO and content performance platforms. Strong research, analytical, and fact-checking skills, with the ability to identify unreliable sources, verify statistics, and reject AI-generated content that does not meet quality standards. Ability to demonstrate measurable improvements in content production efficiency, including reduced research, drafting, editing, and fact-checking time. Excellent written English, editorial judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to structure complex information into clear, engaging, and useful content. A proactive, autonomous, and data-driven mindset, with a strong interest in continuously experimenting with AI tools and improving workflows. Ability to demonstrate real examples of AI-assisted content creation, including published articles, working agent workflows, and a clear explanation of the human contribution versus AI-generated work. Experience limited exclusively to social media, video, or short-form copywriting will not be sufficient for this position. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement. Location flexibility, with the opportunity to work from Anywhere. Compensation discussed during the initial recruitment call. Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-driven content operations, SEO, and Answer Engine Optimization. Hands-on exposure to advanced AI agents, automation workflows, and emerging search technologies. Opportunity to take ownership of scalable content systems and directly influence organic search and AI visibility. A results-oriented environment that encourages experimentation, autonomy, continuous learning, and measurable professional growth. Paid practical assessment for shortlisted candidates as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Content Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Define and lead the content direction, setting editorial priorities and identifying topics and formats with the greatest potential value. Edit and improve new and existing content to ensure clarity, accuracy, relevance, and a consistently high editorial standard. Use AI tools to support content research, drafting, and editing while applying strong editorial judgment and maintaining quality. Lead and support a small team of writers, providing constructive feedback and helping them develop their skills. Take ownership of content performance, tracking results and using data to guide improvements. Improve content visibility through SEO and optimization for AI-powered search, including GEO and AEO strategies. Experiment with new topics, formats, and approaches, evaluating performance and scaling successful initiatives. Collaborate with senior leadership, developers, and product teams to translate technical expertise and product knowledge into engaging, reader-friendly content. Requirements: Several years of experience creating, writing, and editing high-quality content, supported by strong writing skills and sound editorial judgment. Previous experience leading a small team of writers and helping team members improve through clear, constructive feedback. A quality-first mindset, with a focus on content value and impact rather than publication volume. Demonstrated ownership of content performance, with the ability to explain achievements and their contribution to business results. Hands-on experience with SEO and optimization for AI-driven search, rather than experience limited to managing others. Strong practical knowledge of AI writing and editing tools, including the ability to recognize when human expertise and judgment are essential. Experience creating content for software, SaaS, or other technical products, with the ability to explain complex concepts in simple, engaging language. Confidence working independently in a fast-paced environment, making decisions, setting priorities, and evaluating outcomes without requiring detailed instructions. Benefits: Remote working flexibility. The opportunity to own and shape the editorial direction of an established software product business. Freedom to experiment with AI tools and new content approaches. The ability to measure the impact of your decisions through real performance data. A supportive working environment that values its people and aims to provide benefits beyond day-to-day work. The opportunity to contribute to products used by more than 1.5 million websites worldwide.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling Infrastructure
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Build, deploy, operate, and scale production backend services supporting AI-powered developer tools, including MCP servers, agent skills, and AI assistants. Own service architecture and infrastructure decisions, improving system reliability, maintainability, scalability, and deployment processes. Define and monitor service reliability objectives (SLOs), track error budgets, and prioritize improvements in collaboration with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams. Participate in the team's on-call rotation, investigate production incidents, coordinate resolutions, and develop incident reports, runbooks, and preventive solutions. Manage operational support requests and identify recurring issues that can be addressed through long-term engineering improvements. Design and maintain authentication and authorization systems for AI agents and machine clients, including OAuth applications, scoped tokens, permissions, and secure access management. Establish and maintain comprehensive observability through metrics, distributed tracing, logging, dashboards, and alerting systems. Manage AI agent traffic, implementing rate limits, capacity controls, cost safeguards, and mechanisms to handle dependency failures and unexpected traffic spikes. Collaborate with Platform, SRE, Authentication, Billing, and Edge Functions teams to improve shared infrastructure, release processes, security, and operational practices. Contribute to the development of AI tooling infrastructure, ensuring that reliability, security, and performance remain central to engineering decisions. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience building, deploying, and operating production backend services, including participation in on-call rotations. Strong programming skills in TypeScript or Go, with practical working knowledge of the other language. Proven experience designing and maintaining APIs, including versioning, error handling, rate limiting, and backward compatibility. Strong understanding of OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, and API authorization, with the ability to troubleshoot authentication and permission issues in production environments. Good knowledge of PostgreSQL and relational database systems. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, containerized deployments, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems using metrics, logs, and traces to identify performance bottlenecks and service failures. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and work effectively in globally distributed, asynchronous environments. Adaptability, ownership, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while delivering solutions in fast-paced engineering environments. Deep expertise in at least one of the following areas: APIs and Authentication: Experience designing permission models, token scopes, and OAuth flows for third-party integrations or machine clients, including safely migrating authentication systems without disrupting existing users. Production Operations: Hands-on experience managing production services, participating in on-call rotations, developing alerts and runbooks, implementing SLOs, and improving system reliability. Gateways and Distributed Systems: Experience building or operating proxies, gateways, or distributed services, troubleshooting retries, partial failures, upstream outages, and making appropriate fail-open or fail-closed decisions under degraded conditions. Nice to have: Experience with AI agent tooling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or infrastructure serving AI agents and LLM clients. Experience extracting services from larger codebases while maintaining compatibility with existing integrations. Familiarity with observability platforms such as Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or Logflare, along with practical experience implementing SLOs. Contributions to open-source projects, particularly within the Node.js, Go, TypeScript, or API tooling ecosystems. Benefits: Ful

jobs.title: DevOps + Go (Platform Engineer )
jobs.description: Accountabilities: You will take ownership of infrastructure improvements, platform tooling, and deployment workflows across a diverse technology landscape. Your responsibilities will include: Design, build, maintain, and optimize scalable CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD. Support and improve infrastructure across multiple products, including on-premise, cloud-based, and hybrid environments. Develop, maintain, and refactor internal platform tools and services in Go, including a next-generation replacement for the existing deployment system. Independently investigate infrastructure environments, identify weaknesses and bottlenecks, and implement measurable improvements. Optimize staging and ephemeral environments to improve performance, reliability, and operating costs. Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible. Strengthen observability through Grafana, OpenSearch, metrics, monitoring, and alerting systems. Participate in operational support and troubleshooting activities as part of a shared team responsibility. Collaborate with R&D, QA, SRE, and infrastructure teams to improve developer workflows and accelerate software delivery. Work across both modern technology stacks and legacy systems, including Windows Server and Hyper-V environments. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong DevOps and platform engineering expertise with recent production-level Go development experience. You should demonstrate technical independence, sound systems thinking, and a practical approach to solving complex infrastructure challenges. Key qualifications include: At least 3–5 years of DevOps or Platform Engineering experience at a senior level. Hands-on experience deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting on-premise infrastructure, including hardware and infrastructure-level issues. Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider: AWS, Azure, or GCP. Recent production experience with Go, including developing tools, exporters, automation solutions, or backend services rather than relying solely on scripts. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes. Solid knowledge of GitLab CI/CD. Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Experience with observability and monitoring technologies, including Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Prometheus, or VictoriaMetrics. Willingness and ability to work with legacy systems and Windows environments, including Windows Server, Hyper-V, and PowerShell. A strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take initiatives from initial investigation through delivery and measurable results. Independent problem-solving skills and confidence navigating unfamiliar systems without step-by-step guidance. Systems thinking and the ability to understand the full software delivery lifecycle, from code to production. Clear, pragmatic communication skills and an iterative approach that avoids unnecessary complexity. A collaborative attitude, low ego, and strong accountability. Additional experience that would be an advantage includes: Working with multiple cloud providers or hybrid infrastructure environments. Experience with Helm or Helmfile. Familiarity with VMware or other virtualization platforms. Strong networking fundamentals. Experience building or maintaining internal developer platforms (IDPs). Basic frontend development skills, particularly JavaScript or React, for internal tools. Benefits Fully remote, full-time working opportunity. Salary range or initial compensation level shared with candidates during the recruitment process, before employment begins. 28 calendar days of annual vacation. 7 additional wellness days per year for personal needs, recovery, or household matters. Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for recommending successful candidates. 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and professional events. Corporate discounts for English lessons. Health support

jobs.title: Online Science Teacher – Partner School, Term 2 (Environmental & Physical Science)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: You will plan and deliver high-quality online science instruction, helping students build subject knowledge and apply scientific concepts through structured learning activities. Your responsibilities will include: Plan and deliver engaging live lessons covering Environmental Science and Physical Science. Teach key concepts such as ecosystems, sustainability, energy, forces and motion, matter and its properties, and human interactions with the environment. Guide students through the scientific method, including formulating questions, conducting simple investigations, recording observations, and drawing evidence-based conclusions. Use digital teaching tools, virtual laboratories, simulations, and interactive resources to create an effective and supportive online classroom. Assess student understanding and progress, provide constructive feedback, and adapt teaching approaches to improve learning outcomes. Prepare meaningful homework, learning activities, and assessments. Communicate regularly and professionally with students, families, and the wider academic team regarding progress and learning needs. Contribute to the development and improvement of educational resources and the overall student learning experience. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced classroom teacher with strong subject knowledge in Environmental and Physical Science, excellent communication skills, and the ability to deliver effective technology-enabled instruction. The following qualifications and experience are required or preferred: At least 5 years of teaching experience in a school setting. Tutoring experience does not count toward this requirement. Bachelor's degree or higher in Science, Environmental Science, Physics, Science Education, or a related discipline. Strong knowledge of Environmental Science and Physical Science. Availability for the complete teaching schedule from January to March 2027. Excellent communication skills when working with students, parents, and colleagues. Familiarity with online teaching platforms and enthusiasm for technology-enabled education. A recognized teaching qualification, such as a teaching degree, teaching license, or postgraduate certificate in education, is preferred. Previous online teaching experience is an advantage. Experience teaching Environmental Science or Physical Science at middle or high school level is preferred. Familiarity with international or U.S. curricula is an advantage. Benefits Fully remote teaching arrangement. Fixed-term teaching engagement from January to March 2027. Opportunity to teach a small class in a live, interactive online environment. Opportunity to contribute to students' scientific knowledge, curiosity, and academic development. Collaboration with an international education community. Opportunity to use innovative digital tools and technology-enabled teaching resources. Teaching schedule (CET – Spain/Italy time): Monday: 9:15 AM–10:15 AM. Wednesday: 9:15 AM–10:15 AM. Thursday: 9:15 AM–11:15 AM. Onboarding must be completed by December 2026.
