jobs.title: Outbound Sales Development Representative (Maritime)
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. As an Outbound Sales Development Representative focusing on the Maritime sector, you will be the driving force behind expanding Kpler’s footprint across the EMEA region. You will spearhead outbound prospecting efforts, identifying and connecting with key industry leaders to introduce our industry-leading platforms, including MarineTraffic and Kpler. In this role, you will bridge the gap between market intelligence and customer success by creating meaningful sales pipeline that accelerates regional revenue growth. Key Responsibilities: Drive Strategic Prospecting: Map out key decision-makers and organizational hierarchies across target New Logo maritime accounts within the EMEA region. Execute Multi-Channel Outreach: Craft and deploy tailored outbound campaigns across phone, email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp to articulate Kpler’s value proposition to executive stakeholders. Qualify High-Impact Opportunities: Apply the BANT framework to thoroughly evaluate prospective client requirements and determine high-fit opportunities. Generate Pipeline & Book Meetings: Secure qualified discovery meetings for Account Executives to consistently build and accelerate the sales pipeline. Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Business Development leadership to synchronize campaign strategies and optimize outreach around product releases. Maintain CRM Excellence: Systematically capture market intelligence, customer interactions, and pipeline data within Salesforce to ensure pipeline visibility and operational efficiency. Deepen Industry Expertise: Develop a thorough understanding of maritime workflows and user personas to position Kpler's data solutions credibly in every interaction. Experience & Background: What you’ll need (Must-haves): 2+ years of outbound business development or sales development experience in a B2B SaaS/technology environment. Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding outbound prospecting activity metrics and meeting quotas. Demonstrated expertise conducting multi-channel outbound campaigns using modern sales engagement platforms and phone outreach. Exceptional professional communication and active listening skills in English, with the ability to engage senior decision-makers credibly. A structured, hunter-oriented approach with strong discipline in pipeline tracking and CRM hygiene (preferably Salesforce). Nice-to-haves: Domain knowledge or direct experience prospecting into the Maritime, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Energy & Commodities sectors. Hands-on experience applying structured qualification methodologies such as BANT or equivalent qualification frameworks. Practical familiarity with sales engagement tools including LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Outreach. Professional working proficiency in additional European languages. A Bachelor’s degree in business, international relations, logistics, or a related field.

jobs.title: Vehicle Inspection Specialist
jobs.description: Job Title: Vehicle Inspection Specialist Employment Type: Full-time, On-site Location: Soum Car Showroom, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Department: Operations Language Requirement: Fluent in Arabic Role Overview Every car Soum hands over carries our name, so its condition has to be exactly what we promised. The Vehicle Inspection Specialist owns the technical truth about each vehicle: you inspect it when it first comes in, identify and document any damage or defects, carry out the final inspection before handover, and assess technical issues raised after the sale. You also support the Cars Operations team with day-to-day operational tasks. This is a technical role, not a customer-facing one. The After-Sales Customer Experience Specialist owns all customer communication, complaints, and follow-ups. You give them accurate, clearly documented findings so they can keep the customer informed and resolve the case. The goal of the role: no car leaves the showroom with an undocumented defect, every inspection report is accurate and complete, and technical issues are diagnosed quickly and routed to the right fix. Duties & Responsibilities: Vehicle Handover Schedule handover appointments with customers and confirm the time, location, and documents they need to bring. Before each appointment, confirm that the car has passed its pre-handover check and that all accessories are present: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Walk the customer through the car's condition and inspection report, and introduce its key features. Sign the handover form with the customer and document it with photos. Vehicle Inspection & Condition Assessment Conduct the initial inspection of every vehicle, covering the body, exterior, interior, and overall condition, against Soum's approved inspection checklist. Assess mechanical and electrical components, including the engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, steering, and electrical systems. Identify and report any damage, defects, previous repairs, issues, or discrepancies against what was listed or agreed with the buyer. Assess the overall condition of each vehicle and record it consistently, so that condition ratings mean the same thing across every car. Inspection Reports & Documentation Produce a clear, accurate inspection report for every vehicle inspected, written so that a non-technical colleague can explain it to a customer. Take photographs of each vehicle's condition and of every defect found, and attach them to the report. Record all findings, reports, and photos in the system so they are available to Sales and After-Sales. Keep inspection records complete and up to date, so the condition of any vehicle at any stage can be verified. Pre-Handover Checks Conduct the final inspection before vehicle handover or completion, confirming the car matches its inspection report and has not changed in condition since it was listed. Verify that every car is complete with all accessories: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Confirm that the car is ready, or flag what must be fixed before the handover appointment. Post-Sale Technical Issues & Escalation Assess technical issues raised in post-sale warranty requests and complaints, using the case details passed on by the After-Sales CX Specialist. Determine the likely cause, whether the issue was present at handover, and the recommended fix. Document your technical findings in the case so the After-Sales CX Specialist can update the customer. Escalate technical issues outside your authority in line with approved procedures. Workshops & Cars Operations Brief approved maintenance workshops on the technical findings and the work required. Review completed repairs and confirm the issue has been fixed before the case is closed. Feed recurring defects and post-sale technical complaints back into the inspection checklist to improve future inspections. Coordinate with the Operations team throughout the car journey, from initial inspection to handover. Support other Cars Operations tasks when requir

jobs.title: Senior Crude Oil Analyst
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Crude Oil Research Analyst based in Dubai, you will serve as Kpler’s regional market authority on Middle Eastern physical crude dynamics, focusing on refinery activity, product yields, and downstream trade flows. Operating at the crossroads of physical cargo tracking and fundamental market analysis, you will translate complex refinery runs and crude movements into clear, actionable intelligence. In this high-impact individual contributor role, your insights will directly empower global commodity traders and market participants to navigate physical trading, arbitrage, and downstream market shifts with confidence. Key Responsibilities:: Deliver in-depth market intelligence: Conduct rigorous research on Middle Eastern physical crude and refined product markets, focusing on refinery runs, crude throughput, planned maintenance, and physical trade flows . Advance supply, demand, and refinery modeling: Maintain and refine proprietary supply-demand and refinery activity models, ensuring high data integrity compared against international benchmarks such as JODI, EIA, and IEA . Strengthen OSP advisory capabilities: Spearhead analysis and client-facing insights around Middle Eastern Official Selling Prices (OSPs), pricing mechanisms, and crude grade differentials . Publish timely market commentary: Author high-quality research reports, concise market briefs, and ad-hoc commentary highlighting Kpler’s proprietary cargo and inventory data for global clients . Represent Kpler across the industry: Present regional market insights during client briefings, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements to expand Kpler’s thought leadership across the Middle East . Drive commercial and product innovation: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Engineering teams to support pre-sales discussions, demonstrate data value, and co-develop next-generation analytics offerings . Experience & Background:: 5+ years of prior professional experience analysing crude oil markets, with deep familiarity with refinery operations, trading dynamics, and physical trade flows . Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical discipline (Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or Energy Management) . Proven track record of independently researching, analysing, and writing clear, data-driven market commentary and insights . Strong data analytics and quantitative skills, with demonstrated experience manipulating complex datasets to assess supply, demand, and refinery margins . Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to convey technical market context to clients, media, and cross-functional teams . Nice-to-haves: Practical experience using Kpler cargo-tracking data, AIS platforms, or similar energy intelligence tools . Working familiarity with data querying and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or R . Direct familiarity with Middle Eastern crude pricing benchmarks, national oil company (NOC) pricing structures, and regional refinery configurations .

jobs.title: Partner Engagement Manager
jobs.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB The Partner Engagement Management Team is responsible for measuring, monitoring, and optimizing performance of suppliers within a particular set of languages. Performance includes, but is not limited to, on-time delivery, adherence to all client and project specific requirements, and defect-free deliverables. This Team is responsible for understanding customer capacity requirements as communicated by the Program Squads and liaising with Talent Procurement to ensure such capacity requirements can be met. As part of ensuring capacity, the Supplier Performance Management Team will monitor supplier utilization and advise supplier selection to the Program Squads accordingly MAIN DUTIES: The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership of Partner Engagement Manager: Through engagement with Program Squad, make data-driven decisions regarding the most suitable suppliers for a specific account and/or content specialty. Suitability may be based on quality, OTD, market / language strategy, capacity needs, content specialty, or client specific requirements. Lead communication and onboarding of suppliers to new client programs, ensuring availability and suitability for such work. Maintain supplier skilling as it pertains to clients / Pantheon (proprietary) programs. Monitor utilization to ensure supplier usage is in alignment with strategies as defined by Program Operations, Partner Success, and Language Operations. Engage with Program Squads should adjustment in resource usage be necessary. Communicate with and support Talent Procurement in the creation of new recruitment campaigns to identify and onboard new suppliers to Welocalize. Ensure regular quality measuring of suppliers in alignment with Welocalize LQA strategy. Monitor and flag suppliers performing beneath defined Welocalize thresholds. Supplier performance is inclusive of OTD, time-to-accept task, language quality, adherence to instructions, etc. Initiate Quality Improvement Plan (QIP), RCAs or CAPAs, as needed. If QIP is deemed unsuccessful, inform Talent Procurement. Liaise with Program Squad to understand customer capacity requirements and take appropriate actions to ensure such requirements are consistently met. Responsible for overall performance (internal & external resources) of the languages, capacity planning, resource utilization, OTD, and quality. REQUIREMENTS: Education & Experience Proven experience in a fast-paced, client-centric environment, ideally in the translation or localization industry. Knowledge of the language services industry and a keen interest in its technology, process, competitive landscape, and emerging trends. Adept at data literacy; ability to understand and utilize data to make decisions. Flexible attitude with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, time-sensitive, and deadline-driven work environment. Problem-solving mindset that can proactively assess and mitigate risk. Can work within a team, contributing to the team's success, or work independently as needed.

jobs.title: Consumer Product Manager
jobs.description: About Soum Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom. About the Role The Consumer Product Manager owns the experience our customers touch every day: how buyers discover, evaluate, pay for and receive a used phone or car, and how sellers list, price and get paid for what they sell. You will be the voice of the Soum customer inside the product team, turning deep consumer insight into features that grow conversion, repeat purchase and trust in the platform. You will work across the app and web, partnering with design, engineering, operations and commercial teams to ship quickly and learn from what we ship. Key Responsibilities: Own the roadmap for a core consumer area (such as the buyer journey, the seller journey or subscriptions), prioritising ruthlessly by impact on conversion, retention, GMV and customer trust. Build a deep, continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets and behavioural data. Optimise the end-to-end marketplace funnel: listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns and post-purchase experience. Design and improve trust features that make buying used feel safe, including device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings and transparent pricing. Shape the subscription products for electronics and cars: the value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement and retention, working closely with Commercial and Finance on unit economics. Translate problems into clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and run agile delivery with design and engineering, from discovery through release and iteration. Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localisation for Saudi customers. Run a disciplined experimentation practice: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, define success metrics and make fast, evidence-based decisions on what to scale or kill. Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS and customer complaints. Partner cross-functionally with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to make sure product changes work end to end, not just on screen. Keep a close eye on regional and global marketplaces and recommerce players, and bring the best ideas back to Soum, adapted for our customers. Requirements: 2–4 years of product management experience on consumer-facing digital products such as marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech or consumer apps. A proven track record of shipping consumer features that moved measurable business metrics, and the ability to explain exactly how. Strong consumer intuition backed by data: comfortable with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), funnel analysis and A/B testing; working SQL is a strong plus. Hands-on experience building for mobile (iOS and Android) and web. Solid understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including supply and demand balance, liquidity, trust and pricing. Experience working closely with designers and engineers in an agile environment, with clear written specs and sharp prioritisation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management, able to align operations, commercial and tech teams around a decision. A true owner who moves fast, takes decisions with incomplete information and cares more about outcomes than output.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Commodities - Middle East & Africa
jobs.description: About the Role: As an Account Manager for Commodities in the MEIA (Middle East & Africa) region, you will play a pivotal role in driving commercial growth and expanding Kpler's presence across key regional markets. Operating as a strategic partner to our client portfolio, you will identify high-value expansion opportunities, negotiate profitable renewals, and elevate customer relationship management. By connecting client market needs directly with internal strategy, you will help shape product direction and empower regional market leaders with real-time trade intelligence. Key Responsibilities Drive Portfolio Expansion: Direct and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts across the MEA region, systematically uncovering and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities to exceed growth targets. Deliver Strategic Commercial Guidance: Partner with clients to align Kpler intelligence with their multi-year planning, demand forecasting, and operational workflows. Lead Contract Negotiations: Commercialize and negotiate renewals and expansion agreements, ensuring profitable terms and complete compliance with company policies. Capture Market & Competitor Insights: Gather direct feedback from client interactions to inform product development, business unit initiatives, and competitive positioning. Maintain Pipeline & CRM Accuracy: Manage sales activity and account health within Salesforce, providing predictable pipeline forecasts in close collaboration with Sales Operations. Foster Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure seamless client delivery and contribute to broader corporate initiatives. Experience & Background: Experience in Account Management or Sales within a data provider company, with exposure to SaaS or DaaS models (ideally background in financial data or commodities data platforms). Professional fluency in both English and Arabic, with strong written and verbal communication skills tailored for regional client relationship management and negotiations. Proven track record of hitting and exceeding sales expansion targets through structured account planning and proactive opportunity generation. Demonstrated negotiation skills with experience managing contract cycles and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Customer Success, Sales Operations, Marketing). Strong self-motivation, high accountability, and the resilience to excel within a fast-paced, dynamic growth environment.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President – Data Science
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE As an AVP– Data Science, you will design, build, and productionize advanced analytics and AI solutions that drive measurable business value. You will work closely with Data Product Owners, Data Analysts, BI Developers, and Data Quality Specialists to translate complex business challenges into data-driven models and experiments. Leveraging Python, SQL, and modern ML frameworks, you will develop scalable machine learning solutions that are explainable, governed, and aligned with organizational priorities. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Translate business problems into data science projects by defining clear hypotheses, success metrics, and validation methods. Explore, clean, and transform structured and unstructured data using Python and SQL to prepare high-quality datasets for modeling. Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models using appropriate algorithms and statistical techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, NLP, forecasting). Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to productionize AI models through reproducible pipelines and CI/CD workflows. Apply model explainability, fairness, and interpretability techniques (e.g., SHAP, LIME, feature importance) to ensure transparency and accountability. Support AI governance activities, including Model Risk Management (MRM) processes, ensuring compliance and responsible use of AI. Conduct and analyze A/B tests or controlled experiments to assess model and feature performance. Work with Data Product Owners to define business outcomes, monitor model performance post-deployment, and ensure continued relevance. Collaborate with Data Quality Specialists to ensure input data meets quality, lineage, and governance standards. Communicate results effectively through visualizations, storytelling, and presentations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences. RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE 6+ years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, or advanced analytics. Proven experience delivering models that have been deployed and integrated into business processes or digital products. Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Analytics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM). Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and validation. Experience working in Databricks or equivalent data and ML platforms. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and ML lifecycle tools (MLflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of model explainability, ethics, fairness, and governance. Knowledge of AI governance processes and documentation standards, including Model Risk Management (MRM). Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, Snowflake) and APIs for integrating AI models into applications. Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub) and collaborative coding practices. Excellent communication skills to explain technical findings in clear business terms. Collaborative and curious, with a passion for continuous learning and innovation QUALIFICATION Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Master’s degree or higher in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Applied Statistics is an advantage.

jobs.region: Barcelona, Spain / Tokyo, Japan / Portland, OR
jobs.location: Barcelona, Spain / Tokyo, Japan / Portland, OR
jobs.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com ROLE OVERVIEW Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Urdu (Romanized), and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Review pre-release AI model output in Urdu (Romanized) and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE Own the data backbone of the Group: the platforms through which data is ingested, stored, modeled, governed and made available for analytics, Artificial Intelligence and operational use across Aldar and its subsidiaries. Establish end-to-end accountability from data platform engineering to operations, building AI-ready foundations and a self-service model that lets Group Digital and the business consume trusted data at speed, without the data platform becoming a bottleneck. Serve Group Digital's Data & AI teams with data and self-service capabilities; analytics and data science ownership remains with Group Digital. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Data Platform Strategy & Architecture: Define and evolve the Group data platform architecture: ingestion, storage, modeling, processing and serving layers. Design for reuse, scalability, security-by-design and cost efficiency across the Group and subsidiaries. Build AI-ready foundations: pipelines, data products and platform capabilities that support advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence use cases. Data Engineering & Ingestion: Own data ingestion from enterprise and subsidiary source systems into the Group data platform, with reliable, monitored pipelines. Set engineering standards for data pipelines, data products and platform automation. Ensure database management and storage planning support performance and growth. Platform Data Governance & Quality: Implement platform-level data governance: data principles, cataloguing, lineage, quality monitoring and access controls. Safeguard master data alignment and data reliability for downstream consumers. Partner with Information Security on data protection controls across the platform. Serving Group Digital & Self-Service: Serve Group Digital's Data & AI teams with data and self-service capabilities, with clear interfaces and service commitments. Enable governed self-service for business and subsidiary teams, balancing autonomy with control. Provide centralized observability of data flows supporting digital products. Operations & Reliability: Ensure availability, performance and cost discipline of the data platform in production. Establish monitoring, incident management and capacity planning for data services. Drive FinOps discipline on data platform and storage spend. Leadership & Talent Development: Build and lead the Data Platforms team, including data platform and database management capabilities. Develop data engineering depth and support Emiratization objectives. What This Role Is Not: Not an analytics or data science role; those capabilities are owned by Group Digital. Not a reporting or Business Intelligence delivery function; the role provides the platform others build on. Not limited to Aldar corporate; the platform serves the Group and its subsidiaries. This role owns the data backbone on which the Group's analytics and Artificial Intelligence ambitions are built. RELATED YEAR OF EXPERIENCE Minimum of 10-12+ years in data platform engineering or data architecture leadership within large, complex organizations. YOE IN MANAGERIAL POSITION Minimum of 2+ years of managerial experience in a related field. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Enterprise data platforms at group or multi-entity scale, including cloud data stacks Data engineering practices, data governance tooling and self-service enablement Building AI-ready data foundations (pipelines, MLOps-adjacent capabilities) is an advantage TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Engineering leader with architectural depth; credible with both engineers and executive stakeholders Service mindset toward Group Digital and the business: the platform exists to be consumed Rigorous on data reliability, governance and cost discipline Comfortable operating at the boundary between technology platforms and digital product teams QUALIFICATION Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is required Master's degree is preferable

jobs.title: Vice President - Commercials
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE The VP – Commercials is responsible for leading the commercial strategy, financial performance, and monetization of the Darna loyalty programme, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, profitability, and strong economic foundations across all loyalty products, partnerships, and initiatives. This role oversees commercial planning, pricing and funding models, business case governance, and strategic partnership monetization across the Aldar ecosystem. The VP – Commercials ensures disciplined investment decisions, scalable commercial frameworks, and measurable value creation for Aldar, partners, and members. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Responsibilities Define and lead the commercial strategy for Darna's loyalty products and propositions, ensuring clear value creation for Aldar, partners, and members. Establish scalable pricing, funding, and monetization models that balance member attractiveness with financial sustainability. Translate programme growth ambitions into clear commercial targets, revenue streams, and contribution margin frameworks. Partner closely with the SVP – Loyalty to align commercial priorities with long-term programme strategy and ecosystem expansion. Govern investment prioritization across loyalty initiatives, ensuring disciplined capital allocation and return optimization. Establish stage-gate governance frameworks for commercial approvals from concept through launch and scale-up. Identify and unlock cross-loyalty, cross-business, and ecosystem monetization opportunities that drive incremental revenue growth. Functional Responsibilities Lead the development, validation, and evaluation of business cases for new propositions, partnerships, and programme expansions. Define financial assumptions, ROI models, breakeven structures, and funding frameworks for all commercial initiatives. Own the commercial performance of the Darna programme, tracking revenue, costs, margins, and profitability across all products and partnerships. Collaborate with group finance to define annual and multi-year financial planning cycles, including scenario modeling, forecasting, and financial performance reviews. Establish commercial frameworks for loyalty partnerships, including revenue sharing, funding structures, and value exchange mechanisms. Ensure commercial consistency and scalability across partnership agreements and activation models. Secure and manage high-value partnerships across industries such as banking, airlines, telcos, utilities, and e-commerce. Operate, scale partnerships and identify new growth opportunities. Lead strategic projects. Maximize partner and tenant ROI by ensuring loyalty initiatives drive measurable improvements in sales penetration, frequency, and customer value. Identify and manage commercial and financial risks related to loyalty funding structures and partnership agreements. Establish governance controls to monitor revenue leakage, cost overruns, and underperforming propositions. Ensure compliance with Aldar governance, audit, and financial management standards across commercial activities. Support audits and commercial reviews related to financial performance and commercial controls. Insights, Decision Support & Executive Engagement Translate financial and commercial insights into clear strategic recommendations for executive leadership decision-making. Provide regular commercial performance updates and insights to the SVP – Loyalty and senior stakeholders. Represent the commercial perspective of Darna in governance forums, leadership reviews, and cross-functional decision-making processes. People Development Coach and mentor team members to strengthen commercial acumen, financial modeling, negotiation, and partnership management capabilities. Foster a culture of commercial discipline, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. Promote collaboration across marketing, finance, product, and technology teams to embed commercial thinking across the Darna ecosystem. RELATED

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Manager

More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home. Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place. About the Role: We're building our MENA marketing team and looking for a mobile-first, content-first, influencer-first Brand Marketing Manager to bring our brand to life across social platforms. This is a hands-on execution role of the regional strategy that's owned by MENA marketing leadership. You'll be on the ground turning that strategy into scroll-stopping content, creator partnerships, and day-to-day social presence. Key Responsibilities : Execute the KSA social and content plan, translating strategy into platform-native content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn. Shoot social-first content short-form video, reels, stories, behind-the-scenes - on location and at events. Work closely with the social media team on content calendars, scheduling, and platform strategy. Plan and execute photoshoots - vendor coordination, shot lists, on-site production. Recruit, vet, and manage influencer partnerships: identify talent, negotiate deliverables, review output, nurture ongoing relationships. Work with the Events team to turn influencer events into content - capture and distribute. Support in building the collateral operation: brand toolkit, templates, sales materials, presentation decks, signage. Support partnership development with the B2B team - co-branded content, partner marketing, joint activations. Translate large scale marketing campaigns into content opportunities Track performance, report on what's working, and feed learnings back to leadership. Manage timelines and light budgets for the activities you own. What We’re Looking for: 5–8 years hands-on experience in social media, content, or influencer marketing — ideally for a consumer brand in MENA. A portfolio or reel of content you personally created (not just managed) vertical video especially. Fluency in the MENA social landscape — how TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and YouTube behave differently here. Strong instinct for trends and a bias for action. Excellent written and verbal communication in Arabic and English. Additional Nice To have Existing relationships with regional creators, agencies, or production talent. Experience with paid social, analytics tools, or social listening. Practical creator skills: shooting and editing on CapCut, Premiere, or similar. Good eye for pacing, framing, and sound.

We're reshaping how C2C marketplaces operate, making buying and selling second-hand products seamless and reliable. Since our launch in July 2021, Soum has become one of the fastest-growing startups in the region, achieving rapid expansion in both our team and product offerings. In recognition of our impact and growth, we were proudly named one of the Top 10 LinkedIn Startups in Saudi Arabia for 2024. About the Role We are looking for a Finance professional to manage cash and bank reconciliations, inventory accounting, supplier ledgers, VAT, and month-end closing for our cars business. The ideal candidate will have 3–4 years of experience, be ACCA/Part-Qualified CA or equivalent, and be fluent in Arabic and English. Experience in process improvement and automation is a plus. Roles & Responsibilities : Cash, Bank & Receipts Handle all cash and bank matters for the cars business, including issuing and controlling all receipts. Perform daily cash and bank reconciliations; escalate and resolve differences same-day. Report all daily incomes and expenses, fully reconciled to the bank. Inventory Prepare and maintain inventory ledgers, recording daily movement against sales. Conduct periodic and surprise stock counts; investigate and clear variances. Maintain inventory aging analysis and flag slow-moving or at-risk units. Obtain formal sign-off on month-end closing inventory from the Operations team. Recording & VAT Record each cost centre and each stream of business separately and accurately. Own the VAT treatment of every transaction and ensure filings are supported by clean, traceable records. Suppliers & Reconciliations Own key supplier ledgers; prepare statements and secure sign-offs from the Supply team and suppliers. Work with the Inventory & Pricing Analyst to reconcile inventory value, price updates, and P&L. Track marketing expenditure against approvals and budget. Month-End Close Respond to ad hoc finance requests from the CFO and board. Manage the Finance Analyst for reporting and dashboard maintenance. Improve efficiency by reducing manual reporting through automation and tools. Communication & Coordination Serve as the sole channel between the Cars and Finance teams for all financial matters, requests, approvals, and follow-ups. Assess impact on all delivery activities and minimize financial and operational impact. •Identify deviations to original master planning and adopt the master plan design, timeline and/or cost accordingly together with Development Management •Provide regular reporting on construction progress including issues and mitigation strategies •Ensure the issuance of all required government permits and construction licenses. •Ensure possible value engineering ideas are identified to cut costs/time and provide recommendations to project teams. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Real estate developer (GCC). TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS •Deep exposure to GCC region and adjacent markets preferred •Excellent design & masterplanning capabilities •Excellent leadership skills and ability to delegate and coordinate responsibilities •Strong conflict resolution/management skills •Strong team player with ability to balance conflicting priorities and take timely decisions •Excellent analytical skills •Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, required to present master plans to senior leaders for approval. •Experienced in working with and leading multi-disciplinary teams that include members from Business Planning, Master Planning, Design, Project Management, Procurement and Commercial functions. jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. We are looking for a highly motivated Global Account Manager to work with the NOC book of business in the Middle East. This individual is passionate and motivated at the idea of selling a disruptive technology solution in the commodities market and maintaining, deepening and broadening clients’ relationships and sales through renewal, upsells and cross-sells! As an Global Account Manager at Kpler, you will:: Be globally responsible for a named book of business amongst NOC’s across the Middle East and Africa promoting growth within these accounts through identifying and closing upsell and cross sell opportunities and retaining and renewing the clients’ existing spend. Work alongside your account development managers, customer success, marketing and professional services to ensure usage of existing users, uncovering new opportunities and driving the global strategy of your named accounts. Maintain and grow the strong relationships and partnerships in place with your existing client base. Run various trials and data evaluation with new users to expand the account Organize client appreciation events and work with marketing to reward existing clients and maintain our brand recognition What we’re looking for:: 5 years+ experience in sales in the Energy & Commodity space Arabic Speaker Understanding of Energy & Commodity market data solutions and landscape Proven ability in hitting large sales quotas and over delivering Demonstrates an ability to implement a global strategy for account growth backed up by a short and mid term forecast pipeline for the growth Strong interest in building client and product knowledge Driven and self-disciplined. You can work in autonomy without much guidance and thrive in unstructured, fast-paced, ever-changing environments A team player who always puts the business first with an eye on maximizing you and your team’s long-term gains Excellent customer service, listening and negotiation skills Ability to analyse complex client requirements and needs Great attitude and motivation

jobs.title: Vice President – Business Intelligence and Analytics
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE The VP – Business Intelligence & Analytics is a senior, hands-on leader responsible for designing, building, and scaling the organization’s Business Intelligence and analytics capabilities. This role focuses on delivering highly interactive, executive-grade dashboards for CxOs while enabling enterprise-wide self-service analytics through robust data models, governance, and BI best practices. You will personally develop Tableau dashboards used by senior leadership, define semantic and data modeling layers that power trusted insights, and advise, mentor, and lead a team of BI developers to deliver consistent, high-quality analytics across the organization. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Design, build, and maintain high-impact, interactive Tableau dashboards for C-suite executives and senior leadership. Actively optimize performance, usability, and scalability of all business intelligence dashboards and reporting. Architect and roll out self-service BI capabilities, including governed datasets, certified data sources, and reusable semantic layers. Define BI standards, templates, and best practices that empower business users while maintaining governance and data quality. Drive BI adoption and analytics literacy across business functions. Design and maintain advanced analytical data models (star, snowflake, and hybrid models) optimized for BI consumption. Write advanced SQL and Python to support complex transformations, calculations, and analytical logic. Lead, advise, and mentor junior BI developers, providing hands-on guidance, technical coaching, and regular feedback. Establish development standards, code review practices, and dashboard design guidelines for the BI team. Ensure dashboards and reports are trusted, explainable, and aligned with enterprise definitions. Act as a technical authority for BI platforms, influencing architecture, best practices, and enterprise-wide metrics RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE 8+ years of hands-on experience in Business Intelligence, analytics engineering, or data analytics roles. Proven experience delivering executive-level dashboards for CxOs and senior leadership, with a focus on clarity, storytelling, and decision support. Demonstrated success rolling out self-service BI capabilities at enterprise scale, including governed datasets, certified metrics, and semantic layers. Deep expertise with Tableau (Desktop, Server/Cloud), including advanced dashboard design, performance tuning, and scalable deployment. Strong experience designing and maintaining analytical and dimensional data models (star, snowflake, hybrid). Hands-on experience leading, mentoring, or acting as a technical authority for BI teams, while remaining actively involved in dashboard development. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Business Intelligence or Data Analytics TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Expert-level Tableau skills, including advanced calculations, parameters, LOD expressions, and dashboard performance optimization. Advanced SQL for analytics, metric logic, and complex transformations; strong Python skills for data preparation, advanced analytics, and BI automation. Deep understanding of dimensional modelling and analytics engineering principles. Experience building and managing enterprise semantic layers and governed metric frameworks. Familiarity with modern analytics workflows, including version control for BI assets and CI/CD for analytics. Strong focus on data trust, explainability, and governance, ensuring consistent definitions across dashboards. Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills, including direct interaction with executives. QUALIFICATION Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field. Master’s degree and/or BI/analytics certifications (Tableau, data modelling, analytics engineering) are a plus.

jobs.title: Vice  President - Civil Design
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE Lead and manage the Civil Design team, ensuring all projects are designed to the highest standards of quality, safety, and sustainability in line with Aldar development’s standard, value proposition and regulatory requirements. Ensure adherence to project timelines, budgets, and quality standards. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Oversee design and delivery of civil engineering solutions for a variety of infrastructure projects. Oversee the planning, design, and coordination of civil elements, including roadways, utilities, drainage systems, grading, and other infrastructure components. Develop and implement civil design standards, guidelines, and best practices to ensure consistency and quality across all projects. Review and approve civil design calculations, drawings, and models, ensuring accuracy, compliance with regulations, and alignment with client requirements. Monitor the progress of civil design work, identifying and addressing any issues or conflicts that may arise during the design phase. Ensure adherence to local building codes, regulations, and sustainability standards in the civil design process. Conduct site visits to assess conditions, support construction activities, and resolve any technical issues that may arise during implementation. Manage all civil engineering consultants on a day-to-day basis to ensure that designs and technical drawings will be carried out appropriately and aligned with the approved designs. Collaborate closely with architects, structural engineers, MEP engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure the integration of civil designs with other building systems. Coordinate with MEP and architecture design to carry out civil design modifications for interfaces of building structures as required. Manage project documentation and reporting, ensuring all records are accurate and up-to-date. Identify possible value engineering ideas to cut costs/time and simplify delivery, in accordance with project teams. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, technological advancements, and regulatory changes to continuously improve design processes and team performance. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Deep exposure to GCC region and adjacent markets preferred Demonstrated track record in Civil/Structural design for real estate industry TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Strong knowledge of structural design software (e.g., AutoCAD, etc.). Excellent understanding of building codes, safety standards, and local regulations. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail, with a focus on quality and efficiency in design execution. Experience in managing and leading multidisciplinary teams in a design and project delivery environment. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Strong project management skills, with experience in budget, schedule, and scope management. Ability to liaise effectively with clients, contractors, and other stakeholders. QUALIFICATION Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering or related field. Master’s Degree preferred. :

jobs.title: Vice President – Landscape
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE •Support the strategic and operational delivery of Aldar’s landscaping projects by coordinating design development, ensuring compliance with standards, and promoting sustainable, high-quality landscape solutions. Technical and Interpersonal Skills •Proven track record in overseeing large-scale landscape projects in the UAE, specifically in the luxury real estate sector. •Experience in Residential Tower, Villa Communities and Public Realm streetscape projects. •In-depth knowledge of local regulations, codes (e.g., AD 2030, UPC, Estidama), and sustainability practices relevant to landscape design and urban planning. •Extensive knowledge of landscape design principles and sustainable landscaping practices. •Excellent project management skills, with experience in budgeting, scheduling, and overseeing the implementation of large-scale landscape projects. •Proven ability to manage and maintain relationships with contractors, vendors, and external consultants. •Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. •Expertise in landscape planning, design software, and tools (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, InDesign, Adobe Suite). •Strong leadership and team management skills. •Experience in Project Cost Management and Value Engineering Qualifications •Bachelor degree in Landscape Architecture or Environmental Design •LEED certification or equivalent sustainable design accreditation is desirable. •Master’s Degree preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Occupational Safety and Health
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE •Support in the implementation of ALDAR OSH Management system in line to the requirements and legal obligations described by Abu Dhabi Occupational Safety & Health Centre ADOSH across all developments or project scope, particular jurisdiction legislation requirements and nature of work. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES •Update ALDAR legal compliance register, risk register and related Occupational Safety and Health Management System “OSHMS” formats, elements and appendixes to meet (Abu Dhabi Occupational Safety and Health Centre & ISO 45001) ADOSH legal requirements, or any widespread Emirates Authority requirements and implement ALDAR OSH Management system. This including compliance to succeed ADOSH audits and dealing with authority and third parties to close out the pending issues. •Review the trend analysis of unsafe acts and unsafe condition and all incidents and decide whether the existing arrangements are adequate, or additional control measures are applicable. •Review and approve activities specific risk assessments along with approved method statement. This including producing safe working procedures and generate new risk assessment. •Participate in all OSH proactive monitoring programme e.g., management walk, office and site inspection, welfare facilities inspections compliance, site meeting, authority visit, internal and external audits, monitoring the OSH objectives and targets any OSH program or initiatives etc. and issue all required OSH reports. •Organise and cover all OSH requirements related to management review meeting and necessary implementation of new legal and Project requirements. •Conduct regular compliance audit on all involved parties to ensure effective implementation of ALDAR OSH management system and full compliance ALDAR OSHMS elements and related appendixes. •Produce, review and approve OSH documents e.g., emergency evacuation and rescue plans, Lifting plans, OSH Alerts, OSH plan, OSH prequalification etc. this including participating in collecting and preparing any OSH report e.g. OSH sustainability data, OSH monthly dashboard, annual report etc. •Maintain and update the tracking register to the following records: Inspection and close out report, Audit and close out report, ALDAR OSH Management Walk and close out report, Serious OSH incident and non-serious OSH incident along with evidence of incident notification for authority, OSH Enforcement Notice and close out, Risk Register etc. •Follow up with PMC, Consultants and Principal contractor to close out outstanding issues and submit the monthly OSH Reports as per the approved calendar and review in line with ALDAR OSHMS requirements & gather all required OSH data for all reports prior to obtain an approval. •Review each project Monthly OSH Proactive monitoring Programme for full compliance with ALDAR OSHMS requirements and necessary implementation by PMC, Consultants and Principal contractor and obtain approval. •Attend periodic OSH meetings and committee meetings on each project to debate the site wide issues as per ALDAR OSHMS. •Give effective support to cover all projects by Monitoring contractor compliance with OSH rules and guidelines and daily site visits. •Report all major non-compliance infractions to the line manager and project delivery team and set up appropriate action plan for close out. •Evaluate the performance of approved OSH representative and recommend where improvements are required or replacement. •Plan for regular OSH campaigns across all ALDAR developments and engage authorities where required for participation. •Tracking all new legal requirements, changes and advise all involved parties for full compliance •Follow up with authorities and other stakeholders regarding all OSH issues for full compliance this including ensuring the OSHMS is in line with ISO 45001 and ADOSH-SF and dealing with them in case of incident or site visit/audits e.g., ADOSH or widespread Emirates Authority requirements, Abu Dhabi or Dubai Munic
